races.race_name: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)

runners.name: Gold Star Hero
runners.spotlight: Three front-running AW wins in the spring saw him soar up the handicap; he didn't run badly off his revised mark at Epsom on Derby day and last week's Stewards' Cup was always going to be a tough assignment; this is more suitable but others look better treated.
runners.comment: Had a purple patch on AW in spring; high in the weights as a result

runners.name: All Ways Glamorous
runners.spotlight: Made good progress last season and he has improved again this year, finishing third of 17 over C&D on his reappearance and winning at Ffos Las (5f, good) and C&D (good to firm) on his last two starts; up another 5lb but foolish to think he has reached his ceiling.
runners.comment: Progressing well and chasing a hat-trick; 5lb rise for latest C&D win not insurmountable

runners.name: Cinque Verde
runners.spotlight: Fine strike-rate; hit hard for her runaway win at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) in May and she has finished down the field in two runs since; others look more persuasive.
runners.comment: Ran away with 6f h'cap at Newmarket in May bit hit hard for it and well held twice since

runners.name: Fandom
runners.spotlight: Ran on well when third in a C&D handicap last month; not in the same form when down the field in the Stewards' Cup last week; not discounted in these slightly calmer waters.
runners.comment: Good third over C&D last month but disappointing in the Stewards' Cup last week

runners.name: Bolo Neighs
runners.spotlight: His three good runs this year have all come at Ascot, winning in May (6f, good) and doing best of those in the stands' side group when sixth behind All Ways Glamorous here two weeks ago (cheekpieces on for the first time; first 5f run since 2024); can get it wrong at the start but he has races in him off this mark.
runners.comment: Good course form this year and suffered with the draw here last time; seriously considered

runners.name: Kendall Roy
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with a win in a handicap in Bahrain (5f, good); he has raised his game on turf this summer, winning a Listed race at Cork (5f, good; cheekpieces first time) in June; the cheekpieces were absent when he was a fine third in a Cork handicap two weeks ago, doing best of the far-side group, and another big run seems likely.
runners.comment: Still progressing as a 5yo; latest Cork third was on a par with best efforts; contender
runners.owner: Miss Kate McGivern & Thomas Hore & Shane M Power

runners.name: Fahrenheit Seven
runners.spotlight: Began the season with two dominant 5f wins on AW; well short of his best on last two starts (6f, good and AW); returning to 5f won't hurt and the return of cheekpieces could perk him up; can't discount.
runners.comment: Two dominant 5f wins on AW early in year; below par on last two starts; headgear returns

runners.name: Gaeli
runners.spotlight: Looked good when making a successful British debut for Marco Botti at Southwell (5f) in March; no progress since and he was sold for 40,000gns last month; best watched on stable debut despite being back to his winning mark.
runners.comment: Looked good on AW in March for M Botti but regressed since; sold 40,000gns since latest

runners.name: Tuco Salamanca
runners.spotlight: Progressive last year and he has continued the good work in 2026, winning 6f handicaps at Kempton and Newcastle either side of lesser turf efforts, albeit in hot handicaps; has run well at Ascot in the past and although he has yet to race over 5f, he is a strong traveller who could prove suited to it; interesting.
runners.comment: Below best in Stewards' Cup last week but still on an appealing mark; first 5f run today

runners.name: Spartan Arrow
runners.spotlight: Had a fine year in 2025, winning four times including in Listed and Group 3 company; not in comparable form so far in 2026 but the handicapper is easing his burden.
runners.comment: Four wins in 2025, including Group 3; yet to hit top form this year; dropping down weights
runners.owner: Hambleton Racing Ltd XXXI And Partner

races.race_name: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Shrimp Shady
runners.spotlight: Won the 17-runner Chester Plate (2m2f, good) in May on return to turf and went in again last time at Newbury (2m, good to firm), where it was hard work in the end but he travelled strongly deep into the race; only 3lb higher and hasn't had a lot of racing.
runners.comment: Travelled strongly before just holding on at Newbury (2m); just 3lb higher now

runners.name: Pole Star
runners.spotlight: The initial positive reaction to a visor soon wore thin and he beat only one home at Newmarket last time (1m6f) with no headgear (as today); has dropped to a dangerous mark but with some major questions to answer.
runners.comment: Has dropped to a dangerous mark but with some major questions to answer
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Hermetic
runners.spotlight: A lightly raced gelding who won over 1m4f and 2m when trained in France; only his third run for Ian Williams when fourth of 20 in the consolation race for the Northumberland Plate; whether he'll build on that now encountering fast ground for the first time is questionable, especially as he was withdrawn on account of such conditions earlier in the year.
runners.comment: Good run on the AW last time but both his wins in France came on soft ground

runners.name: Spirit Mixer
runners.spotlight: Never involved when defending his crown in the Northumberland Plate but two of his three previous runs this season had been creditable; only 1lb higher than for his last win at Chester (September) and he was a close fourth in this two years ago; would have been tempting but for concerns about him these days on fast ground (only fifth last year on good to firm).
runners.comment: Would have been tempting but for concerns about him these days on fast ground

runners.name: Marnier
runners.spotlight: 2-11 for the Gosdens, scoring for the first time on turf when leading late on at Sandown a month ago (1m6f, good; in regular cheekpieces); later bought for 77,000gns; tackles a new trip here and might well have more to offer; good to firm seems fine.
runners.comment: 2-11 for the Gosdens; tackles a new trip here and might well have more to offer

runners.name: Oneforthegutter
runners.spotlight: Only eighth of ten in a 1m6f handicap at Newmarket a month ago in which he was second in 2024 and won in 2025 (on good to firm); that was yet another below-par effort and hopes rest on the tongue-tie making a difference.
runners.comment: Another disappointing run last time in a race he's done well in; now tongue tied

runners.name: Lavender Hill Mob
runners.spotlight: Useful 1m4f performer and pretty good on his day over hurdles; however, hasn't found his best form this season at 2m/2m4f and has yet to convince as a stayer in this discipline; tried a visor last time at Royal Ascot and cheekpieces return.
runners.comment: Capable performer on his day but has yet to convince as a stayer in this discipline

runners.name: Kilmeaden
runners.spotlight: Hurdle/Flat winner; ran in snatches when a 5l fifth in a 2m fast-ground handicap at the Curragh on what proved to be his final start for Donnacha O'Brien; that last run was his first on ground quicker than good and he does like the mud.
runners.comment: Useful performer in Ireland but didn't look at home on fast ground the last time

runners.name: Dancing In Paris
runners.spotlight: Third in a 1m4f handicap at this meeting two years ago and his run over the same trip here 15 days ago was a step back in the right direction; has some appealing form to his name at 2m, so very much in the mix.
runners.comment: Signs of a revival over 1m4f here recently and has some appealing form to his name at 2m

runners.name: Mountain Road
runners.spotlight: A winner off this mark on the AW just over two years ago when trained by David Simcock; returned from a long absence in the spring and back to his best best when coming from a long way off the pace to win well at Thirsk (2m, good) 69 days ago; back from a break with his yard going well; considered off 4lb higher.
runners.comment: Impressive in how he came from way off the pace to win nicely at Thirsk

races.race_name: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Stem
runners.spotlight: Looked as though he needed further than 1m when a rallying fourth at Newmarket in June and he duly obliged returned to 1m2f at Sandown; didn't have a lot in hand that day but only went up 2lb and he could approve for going even further this afternoon.
runners.comment: Only 2lb higher than for his Sandown win; could approve for going even further now

runners.name: Asgard's Captain
runners.spotlight: Seen mostly at up to 1m4f so perhaps unwise to read all that much into last two defeats over 2m and 1m6f; not impossibly treated on his solid 1m4f form earlier this season, and last year's efforts included a 2l defeat in this (not seen to best effect) and a victory over Insanity at York (1m4f, good to firm); in the mix.
runners.comment: Case can be made on his best 1m4f form; recent defeats were at 2m and 1m6f

runners.name: Insanity
runners.spotlight: Has history in this race, having won it two seasons ago and only a length behind Night Breeze last year (good to firm; could have done with a truer gallop); just 2lb higher than 12 months ago and perhaps unwise to come down too harshly on his defeat at Royal Ascot, especially when his comeback run was so encouraging; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Has history in this race and perhaps best to forgive him his latest effort at Royal Ascot

runners.name: Sportingsilvermine
runners.spotlight: His 1m4f win on good to firm at Newmarket in July reads well but has finished behind Castle Stuart in their recent clashes and beat only one home in the John Smith's Cup four weeks ago; probably vulnerable off this mark.
runners.comment: Has won twice since May but has finished behind Castle Stuart in their recent clashes

runners.name: Castle Stuart
runners.spotlight: Can race freely and hooded for his last two races at York, in the latest finishing a highly respectable third (promoted from fourth) in the John Smith's Cup (extended 1m2f; good to firm) for which he was 4lb well in; now 3lb higher and surprisingly goes without any headgear, but he's got some momentum behind him.
runners.comment: 3lb higher than when third at York but that was in the very strong John Smith's Cup

runners.name: Night Breeze
runners.spotlight: Had three of these behind when winning this last year off 11lb lower (good to firm); looks even better now, probably not seen to best effect behind Sportingsilvermine at Newmarket before a sterling effort at Glorious Goodwood over an inadequate 1m2f; likes it here and he's hard to knock.
runners.comment: Last year's winner returns on the back of a sterling run over 1m2f at Goodwood

runners.name: Enemy
runners.spotlight: Won 1m4f/2m handicaps on the AW early this year; only 3-38 on turf but quite encouraging runs in hot 1m3f/1m6f handicaps before finishing tailed off at Newmarket after starting slowly (1m4f); it wouldn't be a bolt from the blue should he run well but others are safer.
runners.comment: Something amiss last time; his two previous runs weren't devoid of promise

runners.name: Fantasy Believer
runners.spotlight: Veteran with ten wins to his name; behind some of these on two visits to York this summer but wasn't disgraced in a C&D handicap 15 days ago on a rare foray over this far; could have some part to play.
runners.comment: Wasn't disgraced in a C&D handicap 15 days ago on a rare foray over this far

runners.name: Frances Ethel
runners.spotlight: Useful at her best in South Africa; steady progress in three runs for William Haggas, last time going close in a Class 2 1m3f handicap on the AW in December; couldn't put it past her trainer having her cherry ripe after a break for this, a race he won four years ago; stays this far but fast ground would be a first.
runners.comment: Off since December but that was her best run yet for current yard; respected

runners.name: Claymore
runners.spotlight: Dropped into a Class 3 when making all at Windsor (extended 1m3f, good to firm) and well beaten off this 5lb higher mark at Newmarket; he can be up and down, and could finish only eighth in this last year.
runners.comment: A winner two runs ago; can be up and down, and only eighth in this last year

races.race_name: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Sprint (Handicap)

runners.name: Red Spells Danger
runners.spotlight: Thriving since dropped to 6f, winning at Ripon and Hamilton in May and then performing with great credit in hot sprint handicaps on his last three starts; no obvious reason why he wouldn't be bang there once again.
runners.comment: Thriving over 6f this summer, winning twice and running well in hot handicaps since; solid

runners.name: Figjam
runners.spotlight: Just one win to her name from her nine starts but that doesn't do her ability justice as she has regularly acquitted herself well in the face of stiff tasks, most recently finishing close up in a Group 3 at York (6f, good to firm) four weeks ago; interesting on this belated handicap debut.
runners.comment: Several good runs in face of stiff tasks this year; interesting on belated handicap debut

runners.name: Thunder Call
runners.spotlight: Easy win in a 6f maiden at Kempton on his reappearance in May; made light of his opening mark when seeing off 21 rivals in a 6f handicap at York (good) in June; unable to justify favouritism in a hot Newmarket handicap last month but the ground was the fastest he has faced and he didn't look entirely at ease, doing well to take third as things panned out; that form looks strong and he remains with serious potential; of obvious interest if the going is deemed suitable.
runners.comment: Unexposed and almost certainly still well ahead of his mark; fast ground the nagging doubt

runners.name: Jel Pepper
runners.spotlight: Two wins as a 2yo, notably a sales race at Newmarket (7f, good); not so good in 2026 but his mark is easing; hooded for this first run for Stuart Williams (sold out of Oliver Cole's yard for 65,000gns last month).
runners.comment: Chance on peak 2yo form; hooded for yard debut having been sold for 65,000gns

runners.name: Grasmere Boy
runners.spotlight: Suited by the drop to 6f, winning a Ripon maiden in June and following up on his handicap debut at Chester in July (both good ground); only fifth of seven off this mark back at Chester two weeks ago; further progress essential.
runners.comment: Came up shy in hat-trick bid at Chester latest (off this mark); low mileage but needs more

runners.name: Cape Ashizuri
runners.spotlight: Made a winning seasonal/handicap debut at Pontefract (6f, good) in April; flopped behind Thunder Call at York eight weeks ago; that run casts a shadow but he still has low mileage and could well rebound.
runners.comment: Flopped in Thunder Call's York race 8 weeks ago; still has low mileage but needs a revival

runners.name: May Angel
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in his two attempts at sprinting this summer but he hasn't run badly on either occasion; could have a bigger effort brewing.
runners.comment: Unplaced in good sprint handicaps on last two starts but still has some potential

runners.name: American Gulf
runners.spotlight: Five runs as a 2yo, winning on debut (6f, good to firm) and ending his campaign with near misses at Windsor and Salisbury (6f, good to soft and good); gelded during his 310-day absence; career best required.
runners.comment: Promise over 6f as a 2yo; gelded since last seen; career best required to take this

runners.name: Shaatir
runners.spotlight: 6f novice win as a 2yo; better form when fourth in a Listed race at Chantilly (6.5f, AW) in March but less good twice since; 7f and heavy ground are valid excuses for the last two runs and he is not yet fully exposed.
runners.comment: Below par on last two runs but the trip & the ground are valid excuses; still low mileage

runners.name: Havana Hurricane
runners.spotlight: Useful 2yo, winning the Windsor Castle over 5f here last June and running creditably in Group 2 company on a couple of occasions; he has offered more than enough this year to think he had trained on and his mark is slowly dropping; gelded since latest start and one to consider back up to 6f; cheekpieces worn on last two starts are now discarded.
runners.comment: Edging down weights; gelded since latest run and the return to 6f should suit; considered

races.race_name: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Hoseki
runners.spotlight: Stable has captured two of the last four renewals, and this filly is on a roll after completing a hat-trick over C&D a month ago; that was by the skin of her teeth but the second was an improver and the pair were clear; she probably won that day in spite of the steady gallop; strong contender under Saffie Osborne.
runners.comment: Stable has captured two of the last four renewals and this filly is on a roll; C&D winner

runners.name: King Of Berkshire
runners.spotlight: This year's wins at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) and Thirsk (1m4f, good) were from the front; last two defeats suggest his progress may have levelled out, for all that he was tried over 1m6f both times; probably needs his best yet.
runners.comment: Last two defeats suggest progress may have levelled out, for all that they were at 1m6f

runners.name: Archers Bay
runners.spotlight: An improver this season, with his only blip coming on heavy ground in the Italian Derby; got messed about when fourth of the six runners in a 1m2f handicap at Newmarket a month ago (good to firm); not yet exposed and Ryan Moore rides.
runners.comment: Just one blip this year on heavy ground; Newmarket last time never went to plan

runners.name: Royal Poetry
runners.spotlight: Came from behind for clearcut win at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm) but couldn't get past the leader when attempting the same trick at Salisbury; that was under a very capable 5lb claimer off this mark, so has more on her plate now promoted from a Class 5.
runners.comment: In a good run of form but in Class 5s in last two races; this is much tougher
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Level Look
runners.spotlight: 1m2f AW novice winner last year; probably needed his comeback run and ran appreciably better at Chester last week (1m4f, good) when he conceded a head start to an in-form filly; stable has a good record at this meeting; respected.
runners.comment: Lightly raced and last week at Chester he conceded a head start to an in-form filly

runners.name: Pierre Grosse
runners.spotlight: Irish stable won this two years ago; placed in both his handicaps, the latest when headed late on in the Ulster Derby at Down Royal (1m5f, soft); suffered another narrow defeat when the standard-setter in a 1m4f maiden at the Curragh (good to firm); hard to call him progressive, but trainer always respected on her forays here and cheekpieces are a first.
runners.comment: 0-8 and not strikingly progressive; trainer respected and the cheekpieces are new

runners.name: Baltic Fleet
runners.spotlight: Competitive in both his handicaps (1m4f) for George Boughey and left that yard for £170,000; likely to win races for Ian Williams, but he was pulled up after never going at Goodwood only ten days ago (1m4f, good to firm; 25-1) and headgear is soon turned to.
runners.comment: Placed in handicaps for previous yard; ran no race on recent debut for this one

runners.name: Ohara
runners.spotlight: His nursery win (sole success) was on soft but conditions were good to firm when second to Last Verse in a small field at Chepstow (1m4f), since when he's finished tailed off here after suffering early interference; needs his best form yet even if putting best foot forward.
runners.comment: Excuses here last time but needs his best form yet even if putting best foot forward

runners.name: Last Verse
runners.spotlight: Bought for 20,000gns out of Andrew Balding's yard after winning off 5lb lower at Chepstow (1m4f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces); ran okay at Sandown but no more than that in a small field over 1m6f; his new rider will have to navigate from the widest stall.
runners.comment: First and third in his last two races but this is way more competitive than those

runners.name: Blue Hercules
runners.spotlight: Races prominently; 0-5 but bounced back from heavy defeat in Royal Ascot handicap (80-1) to go close over C&D last month (good to firm); raised 2lb for that but ceiling of his ability wouldn't be known just yet.
runners.comment: 2lb higher than for recent near miss here; ceiling of ability wouldn't be known just yet

races.race_name: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap)

runners.name: Bullet Point
runners.spotlight: Strong handicap form last summer, runner-up in both Ascot runs (1m, straight course) before landing a valuable prize at York's Ebor meeting; only 1lb higher today after a couple of low-key runs in May; interesting with cheekpieces now given a go.
runners.comment: Huge chance on 2025 best; quiet in May but returns with cheekpieces enlisted; shortlisted

runners.name: Fondo Blanco
runners.spotlight: Progressive 3yo last year; gelded prior to finishing down the field in the Buckingham Palace Stakes here (7f, good to firm) at the Royal meeting, a run that is easily excused given his draw; now tongue tied; not fully exposed at 1m and he is one to consider.
runners.comment: Progressive last year; poor draw here on reappearance (7f); now tongue tied; can do better

runners.name: Ozat
runners.spotlight: Useful form in Europe prior to joining Ian Williams; he has some uninspiring form figures but they don't tell the whole story as he ran well in the Royal Hunt Cup and had a torrid passage in the Golden Mile at Goodwood eight days ago; edging down the weights and has the assistance of Ryan Moore in the saddle; could go well.
runners.comment: In better order than his form figures might indicate; interesting with Ryan Moore on board

runners.name: Mister Winston
runners.spotlight: Won handicaps at Newmarket and Epsom this summer before finishing down the field in the Royal Hunt Cup; only 14th of 18 at Goodwood (1m, good to firm) eight days ago but that doesn't tell the story of his run as he was travelling well but with nowhere to go for most of the home straight; he will need a career best to win but it is not out of the question.
runners.comment: Two handicap wins this year and latest Goodwood run is easy to forgive; chance

runners.name: Popmaster
runners.spotlight: Solid fourth-place finishes in good handicaps at Epsom and Sandown on his last two starts; suspicion he will prove vulnerable for win purposes.
runners.comment: Solid runs in good handicaps on his last two starts; remains vulnerable for win purposes

runners.name: Serengeti
runners.spotlight: Four runs for Mike Murphy have yielded three heavy defeats and a shock 1m2f win at Windsor in May; opposable on balance of form.
runners.comment: Shock 1m2f win in May sandwiched by lesser efforts; opposable on balance

runners.name: Ebt's Guard
runners.spotlight: Defied a 5lb lower mark in the corresponding race 12 months ago; many good runs in defeat since then, including his fourth in the Royal Hunt Cup, and he is unlikely to be too far away.
runners.comment: Won this race last year off 5lb lower; several good runs since; each-way shout again

runners.name: Cerulean Bay
runners.spotlight: Finished second behind Ebt's Guard in this race 12 months ago when rated 14lb lower; he has earned his lofty rating since then, winning twice at Goodwood last autumn and recording a career-best RPR when second of 18 in the Golden Mile at Goodwood eight days ago; another big run anticipated.
runners.comment: 2nd in this race last year; arrives on the back of a career-best run at Goodwood last week

runners.name: Crown Board
runners.spotlight: He has returned from the Middle East with fine efforts at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) and over 1m on the straight course here (good to firm) in July; should remain competitive under these conditions.
runners.comment: Two good handicap runs last month, the latest at Ascot; should remain competitive

runners.name: Two Tribes
runners.spotlight: Won a valuable 7f handicap here last summer before bolting up in the Stewards' Cup one week later; another fine course run here last month when second of 16 and he was heavily supported for a Stewards' Cup repeat, only to stumble leaving the stalls; that run is easily excused but he is back up 2lb today and his stamina for 1m has to be taken on trust.
runners.comment: Had an excuse in the Stewards' Cup last week; stamina for 1m has to be taken on trust

races.race_name: Betway Leigh Handicap

runners.name: Saxophonist
runners.spotlight: 0-7 but last month's close second at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) was a fine try; nudged up only 1lb; has a sound chance of going one better.
runners.comment: Close second at Doncaster; nudged up only 1lb; has a sound chance of going one better

runners.name: Brighton View
runners.spotlight: Improved efforts of late, brushing aside two rivals at Yarmouth (11.4f, good to firm) last Sunday; should make another bold bid under a 6lb penalty.
runners.comment: Easy Yarmouth winner last Sunday; should make another bold bid under 6lb penalty

runners.name: Mandarin Spirit
runners.spotlight: Won 7f Thirsk maiden last July but her form has plateaued in handicaps; last of four at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm) on latest outing; dropped 4lb since but will still need a personal best.
runners.comment: Form has plateaued in handicaps; dropped 4lb since last run but will need personal best

runners.name: Relentless Hero
runners.spotlight: Steady improvement first four starts, winning Lingfield maiden (1m2f, soft) in June; didn't give his running when last of eight on handicap debut at Chester six weeks ago, but he's in good hands and may well bounce back.
runners.comment: Had been improving prior to poor run last time; in good hands and may well bounce back

runners.name: Lc Tiffen
runners.spotlight: 0-7; some improvement when third at Ripon (1m2f, good to firm; 100-1) 12 days ago, but she's up against it here from 4lb out of the weights; usual hood left off today.
runners.comment: Some improvement when 100-1 third at Ripon, but up against it here from out of the weights

races.race_name: Betway Rose Of Lancaster Stakes (Group 3)

runners.name: Sallaal
runners.spotlight: Superbly bred gelding whose form has hit new heights this season; runaway winner of handicap at Epsom (1m2f, good to soft) on Oaks day and followed up cosily in Listed race at Sandown (1m2f, good) five weeks ago; thriving and looks the one to beat.
runners.comment: Superbly bred gelding whose form has hit new heights this season; looks the one to beat

runners.name: Convergent
runners.spotlight: Successful five times from ten attempts, including in Group 3 at Newbury (1m4f, good) in April, but soundly beaten twice since; now on a retrieval mission and has to concede weight all round.
runners.comment: Five wins from ten goes but well beaten last two starts and must concede weight all round

runners.name: Nahraan
runners.spotlight: Rapidly developed into a smart performer last year, winning Listed Glasgow Stakes at Hamilton (1m3f, good); raced too freely when only ninth in Wolferton at Royal Ascot (joint-favourite) on reappearance; still has untapped potential and the last run may have blown away the cobwebs.
runners.comment: Three wins last year including in Listed race; Royal Ascot return might have been needed

runners.name: Sea Scout
runners.spotlight: Showed he can go well fresh when winning 1m2f Listed event at Epsom last spring; mostly creditable efforts in defeat afterwards (subsequently gelded) but will probably need a career best to make a winning return after ten months off.
runners.comment: Gelded after final 3yo start; will probably need career best after ten months off

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)

runners.name: Fallen Angel
runners.spotlight: Won three 1m Group 1s last year on good or good to yielding ground; well below form on final 4yo start and she folded tamely when last of four in Group 2 Middleton Fillies' Stakes at York (1m2f, good) on reappearance, when lack of stamina was possibly a factor; takes a significant drop in grade and she's the one to beat if back to her best.
runners.comment: Triple 1m Group 1 winner in 2025; well below par on reappearance; clear pick on best form

runners.name: Pacific Mission
runners.spotlight: Progressive 2yo campaign culminated in fine second in the Breeders' Cup Juvenile Fillies Turf; below par in Listed race at York (possibly needed run) and Group 3 at Epsom (ground possibly softer than ideal) this term; some questions to answer but she's a leading player if back to her best.
runners.comment: Runner-up at 2025 Breeders' Cup; below par this term but leading player if back to best

runners.name: Alobayyah
runners.spotlight: Very lightly raced for her age; posted a personal best when justifying strong support in 24-runner Kensington Palace Handicap at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm), leading late on; still unexposed and well worth her place in this higher grade.
runners.comment: Lightly raced; won big-field handicap at Royal Ascot; well worth her place up in grade

runners.name: Rumba Numba
runners.spotlight: Progressive type who followed an unlucky fifth to Alobayyah in handicap at Royal Ascot with a narrow win in similar event at Goodwood (1m, good) 11 days ago; this is a sterner assignment but it's unlikely she's reached her ceiling just yet.
runners.comment: Unlucky at Royal Ascot before narrow Goodwood win; this is harder but she's unexposed

runners.name: Blingy's Sister
runners.spotlight: Reliable 3yo; creditable second in French Listed race (1m, good to soft) two weeks ago, but this looks a much more competitive affair and she has plenty to find on the figures.
runners.comment: Second in French Listed race two weeks ago but this looks much more competitive

runners.name: Aviatrice
runners.spotlight: 0-9 on turf; ran as well as she's ever done on grass when beaten neck in six-runner handicap at Leopardstown (1m, good) three weeks ago, but that still leaves her with a fair bit to find on these terms.
runners.comment: 0-9 on turf; close second in Leopardstown handicap last time leaves her fair bit to find

runners.name: Calendar Girl
runners.spotlight: Beaten only once in four outings as a 2yo, crowning the campaign with a gutsy success in Group 3 at Newmarket (7f, good); should have no problem getting 1m; still has untapped potential and she's an interesting candidate if ready to roll after ten months off.
runners.comment: 3-4 as 2yo, final win in Newmarket Group 3; off ten months but still has potential

runners.name: Silenciosa
runners.spotlight: Ran as well as could have been expected when 80-1 for the 1,000 Guineas in May; still rather green but stuck to her task well when second in Listed race at Sandown (1m, good to firm; 11-1) five weeks ago; needs more progress but she's going the right way.
runners.comment: Still green but stuck to task when second at Sandown; more needed but going the right way

runners.name: Noche Clasica
runners.spotlight: Won Musselburgh handicap (1m1f, good) in good style in April but has since come up short in Listed race here and Group 2 at Ascot (1m, good to firm; last of 15); will need a career best but she's relatively low mileage.
runners.comment: Unplaced in Listed race and Group 2 last two starts; improvement needed; still low mileage

runners.name: Mostar Dreams
runners.spotlight: Regularly makes the frame and she ran up to her best when third in Listed race at Pontefract (1m, good to firm) two weeks ago; this is tougher but she still has each-way possibilities.
runners.comment: Third in Pontefract Listed race last time; this is tougher but has each-way possibilities
runners.owner: J Fyffe, A Edmondson & L McGurty

races.race_name: Betway Ashton Heath Handicap

runners.name: Moonshine
runners.spotlight: Both wins over 6f at Kempton, latterly a handicap 59 days ago, but she was second in a C&D maiden on good last August; hit with a 7lb rise for that latest success but she's a lightly raced filly from a yard in fine form so further progress wouldn't surprise.
runners.comment: Both wins over 6f on AW, including latest, but second in C&D maiden last year; respected

runners.name: Christian David
runners.spotlight: Mixed form this season but last two efforts creditable and the way his challenge petered out late on over 1m at Ascot a fortnight ago suggests this return to 7f could prove ideal.
runners.comment: Feasibly handicapped and faded late over 1m at Ascot latest as if return to 7f ideal

runners.name: Pellitory
runners.spotlight: Three-time 7f turf winner who was close to career-best form when second of 17 at York (7f, good to firm) last month but he weakened to finish well adrift of Crimson Spirit at Goodwood last week.
runners.comment: Good second at York last month but well behind Crimson Spirit at Goodwood last week

runners.name: New Image
runners.spotlight: Reappeared with close third at Redcar in April but hasn't built on it, including last of 15 at Thirsk last weekend; hopes are pinned on a first-time visor having a revitalising effect with Oisin Murphy taking the reins.
runners.comment: Has struggled in recent starts so a first-time visor needs to make a difference

runners.name: Crimson Spirit
runners.spotlight: Better than ever when landing a second 7f Goodwood success of the year in 20-runner event at last week's Glorious meeting (good to firm), with the reopposing Pellitory well behind; a further 4lb rise seems unlikely to prevent another prominent showing from this thriving 5yo.
runners.comment: Second 7f Goodwood success of year at last week's Glorious meeting; should go well again

runners.name: Yanifer
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer; now 1lb lower than for last August's win at Chester (7.6f, good to firm) but his two York efforts this summer have been underwhelming.
runners.comment: Now below the mark he defied at Chester last August but two runs this year underwhelming

races.race_name: Betway Tanners Bridge Handicap

runners.name: Norfolk Blue
runners.spotlight: Ten-race maiden but he's knocking at the door, short of room when second of six at Sandown (7f, good to firm) on most recent outing; Oisin Murphy is a positive booking and the first-time visor could be an extra boost; high on the list.
runners.comment: Ten-race maiden but knocking at the door; new headgear and Oisin Murphy  are positives

runners.name: Galba
runners.spotlight: Well backed and went down only narrowly on stable debut at Sandown (1m, good) ten days ago, just reeled in after leading over 2f out; just as effective over 7f; up 3lb but Conor Whiteley can claim a handy 5lb.
runners.comment: All but landed gamble on stable debut at Sandown ten days ago; should go well again

runners.name: Crafty Blue
runners.spotlight: Revived with the help of cheekpieces to win at Leicester (6f, good to firm) last month, and the way she kept on suggests this return to 7f will be fine; leading contender if the headgear works a second time.
runners.comment: Revived by cheekpieces to win at Leicester; leading contender if the headgear works again

runners.name: Comprador
runners.spotlight: 0-6; no show in first-time tongue-strap at Doncaster (80-1) on latest start; others make more appeal.
runners.comment: No show in first-time tongue-strap at Doncaster on latest start; others make more appeal

runners.name: Black Endeavour
runners.spotlight: Did just enough when winning at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) in June; met trouble and fared best of those drawn high at Newbury next time; almost certainly remains in form and worth another go at 7f; interesting.
runners.comment: Doncaster winner in June and had excuses at Newbury next time; interesting

runners.name: Norcross Brow
runners.spotlight: Thriving since joining Charlie Clover, justifying favouritism at Beverley (7.4f, good to firm; Napolian fourth) 11 days ago; may have more in the tank, although this is warmer and he's 5lb higher.
runners.comment: Thriving for current yard; Beverley winner 11 days ago; this is warmer

runners.name: Flyta
runners.spotlight: Gained breakthrough success at Ffos Las (extended 7f, good) in June and ran respectably when second there next time; this race may be a little warmer but she should be in the mix again.
runners.comment: Two good runs recently at Ffos Las; this is warmer but she should be in the mix again

runners.name: Horace Wallace
runners.spotlight: Off mark in 6f Wolverhampton novice in February but has failed to repeat the form; never dangerous upped to 7f last time; others preferred.
runners.comment: Off mark at Wolverhampton in February but has failed to repeat the form; others preferred

runners.name: Napolian
runners.spotlight: Beat a 1-9 shot in a match at Leicester (1m, good to firm) but hasn't cut much ice since, safely held by Norcross Brow at Beverley last time; bit to prove.
runners.comment: Beat a 1-9 shot in a match at Leicester but hasn't cut much ice since; bit to prove

races.race_name: Betway Capital City Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Lost Signal
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 3yo; faded after being pestered for the lead in German Group 2 in May, but he'd previously posted a personal best when second to the high-class Talk Of New York in conditions race at Newmarket (7f, good) on reappearance; bred to stay at least 1m; makes handicap debut and might have been let in lightly.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 3yo; makes handicap debut and might have been let in lightly

runners.name: Triple Double A
runners.spotlight: Unplaced last five starts, not really finishing his races; carries obvious risks but his three turf wins came over 1m on good to firm ground and he now returns after a wind operation; he's well handicapped if the surgery has had a positive effect.
runners.comment: Unplaced last five starts but well handicapped if recent wind op has had a positive effect

runners.name: Cosi Bello
runners.spotlight: Knuckled down well to justify favouritism here on reappearance but hasn't made the expected further progress; seems to stay 1m but all three successes remain at 7f; concedes weight all round; others preferred.
runners.comment: Hasn't progressed from reappearance win here; concedes weight all round; others preferred

runners.name: Mountain Cat
runners.spotlight: Gained comfortable novice wins at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) and Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW) on first two outings, before fading when seventh in 1m2f Group 3 at Royal Ascot; still low mileage and may well be suited by stepping back down in distance; interesting in first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Faded over 1m2f at Royal Ascot; previous two wins around 1m; interesting on handicap debut

runners.name: Tilted Kilt
runners.spotlight: Both his wins have come on the AW but he wasn't disgraced when eighth of 17 on turf at York (7f, good; 22-1) four weeks ago; stepping back up to 1m should be a help; each-way possibilities.
runners.comment: Not disgraced when eighth of 17 at York four weeks ago; each-way possibilities

runners.name: Inspired
runners.spotlight: Consistent form since being gelded, gaining a deserved success in five-runner race at Hamilton (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago; just 2lb higher and should go well again.
runners.comment: Consistent form since being gelded, winning at Hamilton; should go well again
runners.owner: Fine Claret Racing,Mrs Burke & C Wood

runners.name: Financer
runners.spotlight: Had slipped in the weights before winning at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) in July, and he ran at least as well over 1m at York next time; should be thereabouts again.
runners.comment: Won at Redcar and good fourth at York last two starts; should be thereabouts again
runners.owner: S Bulmer, P Hebdon & R Taylor

runners.name: Leadman
runners.spotlight: All three wins at 7f including at Doncaster (good to firm) in June; has remained in form but he's drawn wide and may not be quite so effective over 1m.
runners.comment: All three wins at 7f; arrives in form but may not be quite so effective over 1m

runners.name: Witch Hunter
runners.spotlight: Followed six duck eggs with a last-gasp win at Thirsk (1m, good) last Saturday under Seamus Cronin, capitalising on some leniency from the handicapper; nudged back up only 2lb; has possibilities if on another going day.
runners.comment: Led late on at Thirsk last Saturday; possibilities if on another going day

runners.name: Yorkshire
runners.spotlight: Back to form when beaten a nose at Doncaster three weeks ago; 3lb lower than last winning mark and seems to retain all his ability, so a serious contender if staying the trip (all wins at 6f/7f).
runners.comment: Back to form when beaten nose at Doncaster; big player if staying trip (all wins at 6f/7f)

runners.name: King Casper
runners.spotlight: Well treated on the pick of his form for Hugo Palmer last year but was 66-1 and showed little on reappearance/stable debut; only 2lb lower and probably best watched.
runners.comment: 66-1 and showed little on reappearance/stable debut; probably best watched
runners.owner: John And Tony Jarvis And Partner

runners.name: Arctic Thunder
runners.spotlight: Failed to make the frame on first four starts this season but revived with a 7l win in four-runner race at Salisbury (1m, good to firm); what that form is worth is open to question and he's back up 7lb, but at least the third has won since.
runners.comment: Revived with 7l win at Salisbury; that form could be dubious but still well in on old form

runners.name: Star Anthem
runners.spotlight: Has gone off big odds and finished well held on last three starts, latest on reappearance after being gelded; slipping in the weights but needs a revival.
runners.comment: Big odds and well held last three starts; slipping in the weights but needs a revival

races.race_name: Betway Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Phantom Watch
runners.spotlight: No great progress in AW handicaps from last October to January but he found a powerful finish to make a successful return to turf at Newmarket (1m, good) in June; beaten at short odds but still matched that winning RPR when runner-up back there (good to firm) a week later; freshened up since; considered.
runners.comment: First and second in 1m Newmarket handicaps in June; considered

runners.name: Suggy
runners.spotlight: Third AW success in his last four starts when comfortably on top over the extended 1m at Wolverhampton eight days ago; he does need to prove he's as effective on turf (0-5 but was second in a nursery on soft last year) but he had them well strung out at Dunstall Park and could still be well treated even after a further 7lb rise.
runners.comment: Plenty to spare when landing third AW win of summer last week; 7lb rise may not stop him

runners.name: Sandy Craic
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the ninth attempt when winning at Carlisle (7f, good) in June; has matched that form when runner-up around 1m on good to firm off this mark on both starts since; likely to be on the premises again.
runners.comment: Won over 7f at Carlisle in June; runner-up over 1m off this mark twice since; thereabouts

runners.name: Sunshine And Roses
runners.spotlight: Got up late to shed her maiden tag at the 12th attempt at Wolverhampton (8.6f) 18 days ago; comfortably held on both turf starts but it's too soon to suggest she won't prove as effective on the grass.
runners.comment: 12th run when gaining breakthrough win on AW latest; needs to prove she's as good on turf

runners.name: Home Hero
runners.spotlight: Rallied well in first-time visor dropped back to 1m at Sandown (good to firm) last week but only fifth under a penalty at Newmarket (1m, good to firm again) on Thursday; will run off 2lb lower if turned out again quickly.
runners.comment: Came good in first-time visor at Sandown last week but only fifth at Newmarket on Thursday

runners.name: Golden Mabel
runners.spotlight: String of poor efforts at huge prices this season; expect more of the same.
runners.comment: String of poor efforts at huge prices this season; expect more of the same

races.race_name: Newsells Park Stud Sweet Solera Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies)

runners.name: Harlequin Sky
runners.spotlight: Creditable sixth in Group 3 kept to 6f at Ascot last time, backing up the form of her third in the Windsor Castle; record is 0-4 but she's one of the main form contenders and shapes as if this return to 7f is well worth exploring.
runners.comment: Creditable sixth in Group 3 kept to Ascot, backing up the form of her Windsor Castle run

runners.name: Nuit d'Eclair
runners.spotlight: Night Of Thunder filly who has shown significant promise over 6f, winning at Newbury then close fourth in Ascot Group 3, both on good to firm ground; looks likely to stay 7f; leading form contender and open to further improvement.
runners.comment: Won at Newbury then ran well in Ascot Group 3; leading form contender upped in distance

runners.name: Graceful Song
runners.spotlight: Nicely bred filly, by Dubawi and the first foal of a dual Group 3 winner; justified favouritism, fairly comfortably, in C&D contest (good to firm) last month and looks a useful prospect; represents last year's winning yard; respected.
runners.comment: Nicely bred; justified favouritism, fairly comfortably, in C&D contest; useful prospect

runners.name: China In Your Hand
runners.spotlight: Twice-raced daughter of Cracksman; makes a suitable next step having registered a 2l success, without needing maximum pressure, in C&D maiden (good to firm) last time; interesting contender with further progress plausible.
runners.comment: Recorded a 2l success in C&D maiden last time; further progress is plausible; interesting
runners.owner: C Wright Mrs C Corbett G Hargreave

runners.name: Martinet
runners.spotlight: Well-bred filly, by Frankel out of a Group 1 winner; made all for ready success at Thirsk (7f, good to firm) last time, building on her AW effort; brings potential and adds interest.
runners.comment: Well bred; made all for ready win at Thirsk last time; brings potential and adds interest

runners.name: Sugar Yes Please
runners.spotlight: First foal of an ordinary 7f/1m winner (RPR 69) for her connections; already better than her mother, having recorded an RPR of 74 when justifying favouritism in the latest of two starts over 6f at Newbury; needs to improve further.
runners.comment: Justified favouritism in the latest of two starts at Newbury; needs further progress

runners.name: Tie A Navyribbon
runners.spotlight: Belied her 100-1 odds with third-place finish, beaten almost 4l, in the C&D event won by Graceful Song; needs to prove she can back up that promise and this is a much stiffer assignment.
runners.comment: Beaten almost 4l by Graceful Song in C&D event; this is a much stiffer assignment

races.race_name: William Hill Epic Boost Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Sanbona Warrior
runners.spotlight: Perhaps failed to improve in holding on only narrowly at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) but backed up his debut promise and, having raced only twice, may do better yet; not dismissed.
runners.comment: Held on only narrowly at Doncaster last time but may do better still
runners.owner: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar

runners.name: Regal Tiger
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced colt who has shown steady improvement over 6f, half-length second when favourite for Windsor nursery (good to firm) most recently; bred to be suited by this step up in distance; respected.
runners.comment: Has shown steady improvement over 6f; bred to be suited by this step up in distance

runners.name: Eabha
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced filly who proved suited by the step up to 7f in Epsom maiden (good to firm) most recently, justifying favouritism by 1l; may build on that win and show further progress kept to same distance.
runners.comment: Suited by the step up to 7f in Epsom maiden; may build on that win and improve further

runners.name: Mysterious Times
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced Godolphin colt whose reasonably consistent sprint form features a good effort (beaten two short heads) at Newmarket; may be capable of progress now handicapping and upped to 7f; solid claims.
runners.comment: Sprint form features a good effort at Newmarket; may show progress now handicapping

runners.name: Betty Boop
runners.spotlight: Justified favouritism over 6f at York (good to firm) last time, building on her eye-catching 5f effort; out of a 7f 2yo scorer and looks open to additional improvement upped further in trip; enters calculations.
runners.comment: Scored over 6f at York last time; open to additional progress upped further in trip

runners.name: Theheatison
runners.spotlight: Has something to find with Regal Tiger on last-time Windsor running and that effort didn't suggest he's crying out for a return to 7f; gained his narrow novice win at Bath over 5.7f.
runners.comment: Has something to find with Regal Tiger on last-time running

runners.name: Desert Legend
runners.spotlight: Nursery debutant whose sprint novice form features a couple of third-place finishes, latest over 5f at Lingfield; doesn't particularly give the impression he's crying out for this new trip.
runners.comment: Has shown ability but may not be crying out for this new trip

runners.name: Rhodes Runner
runners.spotlight: Four-race maiden who needs to rebound, having taken her first step backwards last time; ran well on nursery debut earlier in July but that was in a lower grade and on AW.
runners.comment: Needs to rebound, having taken her first step backwards last time

races.race_name: Tattersalls £40,000 EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Unraced Horses) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Godspeed Girl
runners.spotlight: 200,000gns yearling; by Lope De Vega and first foal of German 1m2f-1m4f winner (including Listed; RPR 101) whose siblings include useful 1m-1m2f scorer (including 2yo) Greatgadian; may not flourish until sent over longer trips.
runners.comment: 200,000gns yearling; pedigree suggests she may not flourish until sent over longer trips

runners.name: Watch Party
runners.spotlight: 300,000gns yearling; by Lope De Vega; sister to 1m1f winner Queen Of The Bogs (RPR 94); dam 1m-1m2f scorer (including AW Group 3; 106), half-sister to Australian 1m1f/1m2f Group 1 winner Delius; one of the likelier sorts based on sales information.
runners.comment: 300,000gns yearling; by Lope De Vega; one of the likelier sorts based on sales info

runners.name: Harlequin Dream
runners.spotlight: 55,000gns yearling; by Churchill; sibling to eight winners, notably Ventura Storm (1m-12.5f including 2yo/Italian Group 1; 115); dam maiden; brings the lowest price tag among the runners who went through the sales ring.
runners.comment: 55,000gns yearling; by Churchill; others are more interesting

runners.name: Rubyroo
runners.spotlight: 140,000gns yearling; by Supremacy; sibling to two winners, notably Sayidah Dariyan (6f including 2yo/Group 3; 115); dam French 7f scorer, sister to 5f Group 2 winner Finsbury Square; likely type on breeding.
runners.comment: 140,000gns yearling; by Supremacy; likely type on breeding

runners.name: Thi Qar
runners.spotlight: 260,000gns yearling; Mehmas half-sister to winners Topteam (10.3f/1m4f; RPR 96) and Queen Tamara (7f 2yo; 79); dam runner-up 1m4f, half-sister to Group-placed 1m 2yo/1m2f scorer King's Gambit; market confidence behind this Gosden runner should be noted.
runners.comment: 260,000gns yearling; market support for this Gosden runner should be noted

runners.name: Lex Victoria
runners.spotlight: 98,000gns yearling, then topped the 2026 Arqana May Breeze Up Sale by fetching 1,100,000euros; Sioux Nation half-sister to 1m 2yo/1m1f winner Port Darwin (RPR 66); dam 5.5f-6.5f scorer (including German Listed; 104), out of 6.7f/7f Group 3 winner; wears tongue-tie; stable is operating at an impressive strike-rate with 2yos this term and landed this race last year with a seven-figure Arqana breeze-up buy; very interesting.
runners.comment: Topped the 2026 Arqana May Breeze Up Sale by fetching 1,100,000euros; very interesting

runners.name: Just Scarlet
runners.spotlight: 240,000gns yearling; by Justify and first foal of 6f 2yo/French 1m Listed scorer (RPR 105) whose siblings include 8.5f Canadian Grade 3 winners Grizzel; not ideal to see headgear (hood) fitted so early; market may offer further guidance.
runners.comment: 240,000gns yearling; by Justify; not ideal to see headgear (hood) fitted so early

races.race_name: William Hill Extra Place Races Daily Handicap

runners.name: Angel Hunter
runners.spotlight: Gained most recent success in AW Vase race on Good Friday; has steadily got back into the swing of turf racing and went very close at Thirsk (7f) last Saturday, running at least as well as he's ever done; the signs are positive.
runners.comment: Went very close at Thirsk last Saturday, running at least as well as he's ever done

runners.name: Castle Rock
runners.spotlight: Built on debut promise by completing a Newmarket double (7f/6f) last October and the form has received several boosts since; came off a true line last time but may keep straighter with headgear now applied; open to further progress and commands respect on handicap/seasonal debut, especially if the betting speaks positively.
runners.comment: Form of his Newmarket double last October has been boosted; respected on reappearance

runners.name: Military Code
runners.spotlight: Campaigned mostly over 5f; proved useful (twice Listed placed) last term; well below par in two runs this season but gives the impression he has possibly lost some of his speed; may prove resurgent upped in distance with hood fitted on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Has possibly lost some of his speed; may prove resurgent upped in trip on handicap debut

runners.name: Kodi Lion
runners.spotlight: Back on last winning mark but is by no means certain to take advantage, having finished last of nine at Doncaster on seasonal debut; admittedly may fare better with that outing under his belt.
runners.comment: On last winning mark but failed to beat a rival at Doncaster on seasonal debut
runners.owner: D J Cash & Mrs E Cash Racing

runners.name: Humam
runners.spotlight: Scored three times for previous yard but is 0-8 for current stable and not particularly solid on 2026 form that includes mostly duck eggs, beaten 8l with tongue-tie fitted at Glorious Goodwood most recently; perhaps best watched unless the market speaks favourably.
runners.comment: Not solid on 2026 form; best watched unless the market speaks favourably

runners.name: Pinatubo's Legacy
runners.spotlight: Showed major promise (won then good third) in two AW starts last autumn/winter; failed to transfer the form to turf in C&D handicap at the July festival but may do better still, being such a lightly raced 4yo.
runners.comment: Failed to transfer his AW promise to turf in C&D handicap but may do better still

runners.name: Sword
runners.spotlight: One win apiece for his previous two yards; 0-4 this season for new stable but is in form, close fifth at Ascot most recently; getting no respite from the assessor, so the 7lb claimed by Olivia Haines looks a help.
runners.comment: Getting no respite from the assessor, so the 7lb claimed by Olivia Haines looks a help

runners.name: Arctic Dawn
runners.spotlight: Has developed into a useful 7f handicapper; excusable effort at Royal Ascot is flanked by good performances, namely a ready success at Doncaster and sixth-place finish in the International at Ascot; still on career-high mark but can't be dismissed.
runners.comment: Good sixth in the International at Ascot; still on career-high mark but not dismissed

runners.name: Betty Clover
runners.spotlight: Well treated on best Listed/Group form but has lost her solidity and was soundly beaten in Royal Ascot handicap (1m) most recently; still on a losing sequence that goes back to May 2024.
runners.comment: Has lost her solidity and remains on a losing sequence that goes back to May 2024

runners.name: Morte Point
runners.spotlight: Record since wearing blinkers comprises a win at Chepstow, creditable sixth in competitive field at York and excusable effort (race didn't go smoothly) at Glorious Goodwood; could go well in the retained headgear.
runners.comment: Perhaps best to forgive latest effort; may still have more to offer in blinkers

races.race_name: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap

runners.name: Drymee
runners.spotlight: Hat-trick seeker who has very low mileage; the form of his Class 5 success at Newbury (1m, good to firm; handicap debut) last time has been franked by the runner-up since; upped in grade but receives weight all round and looks open to further progress; respected.
runners.comment: Hat-trick seeker whose latest win has been franked; open to further progress; respected

runners.name: Go Rimbaud
runners.spotlight: Has built up a stronger record on AW than on turf and may be more interesting when back in that sphere; behind Runswick when fitted with cheekpieces at Glorious Goodwood last time; headgear retained.
runners.comment: Has built up a stronger record on AW than on turf; others have less to prove

runners.name: Man Of Vision
runners.spotlight: Campaigned over 7f last year and 6f this term; went close on the other course at Newmarket on reappearance but has regressed in two runs since; chance depends on the effects of new trip and first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Chance of a turnaround depends on the effects of new trip and first-time headgear

runners.name: Luzon Heights
runners.spotlight: Disappointing at York last time; has proved consistent otherwise and may rebound, provided he takes well to first-time headgear; 0-7 on turf but went very close at Yarmouth (1m) on penultimate outing.
runners.comment: Disappointing last time; consistent otherwise and may rebound; wears first-time headgear

runners.name: Runswick
runners.spotlight: Broadly progressive form switched to handicaps this term features a win at Carlisle; far from disgraced when one of several late closers behind the well-supported winner in big field at Glorious Goodwood (kept to 1m) most recently; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Broadly progressive this term; far from disgraced at Glorious Goodwood; shortlisted

runners.name: Vincenzo Peruggia
runners.spotlight: Has failed to back up a good reappearance effort and finished behind two of today's rivals, albeit having raced wide, at Glorious Goodwood most recently (first run since being gelded); something to prove.
runners.comment: Has failed to back up a good reappearance effort; something to prove

runners.name: Looka
runners.spotlight: Handicap debutant who has to overcome top weight and a near year-long absence but is worth noting if the market speaks favourably; faced a difficult task in the 2025 Solario when last seen; won on AW the time before.
runners.comment: Handicap debutant who has to overcome top weight and a near year-long absence

races.race_name: Keep Your Raceday Positive Handicap

runners.name: Thornaby Pearl
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer who made it three wins in his last five starts when making all at Musselburgh (5f, good) last Friday; it's over three years since he defied a mark this high but he has to be respected in his current mood.
runners.comment: Thriving, making it three wins in last five starts at Musselburgh last Friday

runners.name: Lion's House
runners.spotlight: Yet to win on turf, but is now 2lb lower than when scoring on Tapeta at Newcastle (5f) in February and he did well under the circumstances when fourth of 11 at Ayr (5f, good to firm) 26 days ago, faring best of those from off the pace (started slowly); a rare Newmarket runner for his Scottish stable.
runners.comment: Yet win on turf but did well from too far back latest; Scottish yard doesn't run many here

runners.name: Loleeta
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who won a Lingfield AW novice last August; best effort in handicaps when second at Southwell (5f, AW) under Chloe Lyons (who partners stablemate Merrimack here) in April but well held back on turf the following month; off since.
runners.comment: Second on Southwell's AW in April but well held on turf next time; off 87 days

runners.name: Merrimack
runners.spotlight: Tough and consistent sort who made all over C&D (good to firm) under Chloe Lyons last Saturday; raised 5lb but likely to give it his usual good shot.
runners.comment: Consistent and made all over C&D under Chloe Lyons last Saturday; should go well again

runners.name: Our Planet
runners.spotlight: Won a Leicester maiden (5f, good) on stable debut last July but has found it harder in handicaps since, including sixth of seven on Lingfield (turf) reappearance a fortnight ago.
runners.comment: 5f maiden win last summer but has largely struggled in handicaps since

runners.name: Brave Nation
runners.spotlight: 6yo who is well handicapped on last season's best efforts for Michael Bell and made quite an encouraging start for his new yard when third of seven at Sandown (5f, good to firm) 16 days ago, particularly as he was tight for room against the rail; given a chance to build on that with Billy Loughnane taking the reins this time.
runners.comment: Well handicapped and decent start for new yard at Sandown; player under Loughnane

races.race_name: William Hill Price Boosts Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Jack Langley
runners.spotlight: Positive start for the Charlie Clover yard, readily landing a small-field affair at Lingfield (1m5f, good to firm) in June; beaten favourite but bettered that winning RPR when second (well clear of rest) at Nottingham (1m6f, good to firm) five weeks ago; gets the vote.
runners.comment: Good start for the Charlie Clover and a further 2lb nudge may not stop him here

runners.name: Prince Quattro
runners.spotlight: Back to winning ways in 2m course handicap (good to firm) under Mason Paetel in June, with reopposing Dereham 5l back in third; good third of 12 in competitive Market Rasen handicap hurdle (extended 2m4f, good) since; likely to go well back on the Flat.
runners.comment: 2m course win in June and good third over hurdles since; likely to go well
runners.owner: Ursa Major Ltd & Hicky Parmar Racing

runners.name: Fram Castle
runners.spotlight: Sole win came in a 2m AW handicap for Dominic Ffrench Davis last June but he went very close to a second on just his second outing for Michael Wigham when short-headed at Lingfield (extended 2m, good to firm) under Alexandra Egan 17 days ago; the first-time visor he wore at Lingfield is retained.
runners.comment: Second start for this yard when going close at Lingfield (turf) in a visor last time

runners.name: Stitching Wheel
runners.spotlight: Ex-French filly who capitalised on a reduced mark when gaining a first win at the 14th attempt in 1m6f handicap at Redcar (good) in June; creditable second of four over 2m there (good to firm) since, both under today's rider Cian Horgan.
runners.comment: Arrives on the back of a win (1m6f) and second (2m) at Redcar under Cian Horgan

runners.name: Dereham
runners.spotlight: 10yo whose last three wins (in 2022, 2023 and 2025) came in the 2m handicap he contested here six weeks ago; could only manage 5l third to the reopposing Prince Quattro in this year's renewal; 4lb better off with that rival this time but it may not be enough.
runners.comment: Last three wins over 2m here; 5l third to Prince Quattro here latest

runners.name: Baltic
runners.spotlight: Won five in a row at around 1m4f on turf/AW for the Charltons between September 2023 and July 2024; suffered heavy defeats on first three starts back from an absence for new yard and latest second of three at Yarmouth (1m6f, good to firm) in this headgear combination was no big step back in the right direction as he was beaten 8l.
runners.comment: Hasn't threatened for new yard back from absence, beaten 8l when second latest

races.race_name: Wexford Fillies Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Ballyhahill
runners.spotlight: Not a bad run on debut in a Limerick maiden hurdle but bitterly disappointing twice since; completely tailed off in a Cork bumper latest; new cheekpieces need to spark.
runners.comment: Promise on debut but bitterly disappointing twice since, new cheekpieces need to spark
runners.owner: David Spratt & Kevin McMunigal & Mark Hopkins

runners.name: Felicity Smoak
runners.spotlight: The most experienced filly in the field; not beaten far when third of 16 off 97 in a Cork handicap hurdle last time out; should run her race but probably vulnerable back in a maiden.
runners.comment: Experienced filly, beaten off 97 in handicap latest, vulnerable back in a maiden
runners.owner: E Dillon & B Power & J J Whelan & K R Waplington

runners.name: Sonas
runners.spotlight: Walk In The Park filly; half-sister to winners Skyace (useful 2m-3m hurdle) and Still Ciel (1m7f hurdle); unraced dam out of bumper-winning half-sister to 3m1f chase winner Skeheenarinky; nicely bred but overlooked by Darragh O'Keefe.
runners.comment: Walk In The Park filly, half-sister to useful Skyace, overlooked by O'Keefe

runners.name: Tell The Boys
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the third attempt in bumpers at Listowel on her penultimate start; reportedly made a noise in running when below best in a bumper at Roscommon on latest; capable of better and should take to this discipline on breeding; player.
runners.comment: Bumper winner, had valid excuse for poor run on latest, bred to make a hurdler, player

runners.name: Willows Word
runners.spotlight: Poet's Word filly; dam French 1m4f/1m5f AW winner, half-sister to 1m6f Group 3 winner Trip To Rhodos and 1m2f Listed winner Danza Cavallo, out of Listed-placed 1m 2yo winner; tongue tied for debut; watch.
runners.comment: Poet's Word filly, dam AW winner, tongue tied for debut, watch

runners.name: Staywitherjohnny
runners.spotlight: 0-9 on the Flat and rated just 54; not bred to make a jumper and is probably best watched on hurdling debut.
runners.comment: 0-9 on the Flat and rated 54, not bred to jump, best watched on hurdling debut

runners.name: Banner Beauty
runners.spotlight: Won a Leopardstown maiden on the Flat on debut for this yard in May 2025 but lost way since and now switches to hurdles; not bred for this game; tongue tie goes on; watch.
runners.comment: Lost way since Flat maiden win last year, not bred for this game, tongue tied
runners.owner: O B P Carroll & Anthony Vaughan

runners.name: Kingside Lady
runners.spotlight: Purchased for E100,000 after comfortably winning mares' maiden point-to-point at Ballindenisk; failed to run to market expectations when tailed off in a Bellewstown bumper last month; surely better than that and too soon to write off.
runners.comment: Point winner, failed to deliver when fav' for Bellewstown bumper, too soon to write off

runners.name: Baby Pearl
runners.spotlight: Sent off at 11-2 for an academy hurdle at Navan in December but tailed off having been hampered; surely capable of better than that and worth a market check on return from a 245 day break.
runners.comment: Disappointed in academy hurdle in December, may be capable of better, check market

runners.name: Casheldale Lass
runners.spotlight: Flat winner rated 62 in that sphere; made a modest start over hurdles when beaten 22l at Sligo last month; will need to improve plenty on that to feature here.
runners.comment: 62 rated on Flat, modest start over hurdles on latest, needs to improve plenty on that

runners.name: Shakita
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose maiden; 0-4 over hurdles and rated 89; well beaten on Flat on last two starts; new tongue tie needs to have dramatic effect.
runners.comment: Dual-purpose maiden, 0-4 over timber and rated 89, tongue tie now tried

races.race_name: Shamrock Farm Enterprises Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Ocean Murphy
runners.spotlight: Off the mark in decisive fashion over C&D 16 days ago; a 6lb rise for that 5.5l win seems lenient and he may be hard to stop if turning up here in a similar mood.
runners.comment: 6lb rise for decisive C&D win 16 days ago seems fair, the one to beat if in similar mood

runners.name: Harpy Eagle
runners.spotlight: 0-12 over hurdles but has run well in defeat, including when runner up in a 2m1f (good) maiden hurdle here; went close off 3lb higher at Galway in October; wide trip when midfield over C&D (good) on latest; not discounted off 2lb lower.
runners.comment: 0-12, has run well in defeat, wide trip when midfield over C&D latest, eased 2lb, chance

runners.name: Isdistheone
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; modest form in bumpers and maiden hurdles on varying ground; tongue tie goes on for handicap debut; best watched unless the market speaks.
runners.comment: Modest form in bumpers and maidena, tongue tie on for h'cap debut, watch unless backed

runners.name: Marian Avenue
runners.spotlight: 0-7 over timber; was first past the post on latest at Limerick (2m4f, soft) but was disqualified for causing interference; previously went close on better ground at Punchestown so conditions no concern; should go well again off 5lb higher.
runners.comment: First past post but disqualified at Limerick, raised 5lb, ground fine, go well again

runners.name: Camino Rock
runners.spotlight: Just 1-24 over hurdles and that win came in 2024; finished last season bang out of form and similar story at Galway after a break on latest; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Sole win over timber in 2024, bang out of form in recent starts, hard to fancy

runners.name: It's Bobsled Time
runners.spotlight: 250-1 academy hurdle winner for Richard Morrissey; form otherwise poor but has joined a shrewd yard ahead of handicap debut and notable that trainer rides (2-5 this season, 12-27 last season); market check advised on return from six month break.
runners.comment: 250-1 academy hurdle winner, new yard, handicap debutant, needs checking in market

races.race_name: Wexford Racecourse Park Run Beginners Chase

runners.name: Nadia's Boy
runners.spotlight: Point, bumper and maiden hurdle winner (solid form) bounced back from a poor Punchestown novice hurdle run to finish a close third on chase debut over 2m here in June (0.5l behind William Tell); this longer trip fine and every chance.
runners.comment: Fine chase debut over 2m here latest, closely matched with William Tell, obvious chance

runners.name: William Tell
runners.spotlight: Went close on chase bow here (2m) in June (Nadia's Boy and Scalpnagoon behind) but unseated back here next time and out of depth in hot 2m2f Galway beginners' chase on latest; this looks less demanding, this longer trip will suit and he is a leading contender with rider claiming valuable 7lb.
runners.comment: Promising chase debut here in May, out of depth latest, leading claims upped in trip

runners.name: Scalpnagoon
runners.spotlight: Well held behind William Tell and Nadia's Boy in a 2m beginners' here in June; no match for Charlie Luciano upped to 25.5f at Kilbeggan latest; this trip more suitable but he's 0-7 over fences now and needs to find more to get his head in front.
runners.comment: Well behind two of these here in May, 0-7 over fences now, needs to find more

runners.name: Kelya
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles when trained in France on very soft; 66-1 and beaten 35l on debut for this stable in a Limerick Grade 3 novice hurdle; this more realistic and bred to make a chaser but best watched unless the market speaks.
runners.comment: French hurdles winner, out of depth on Irish debut, best watched unless market speaks

runners.name: Jackson Lamb
runners.spotlight: Bumper and hurdles winner is 0-3 over fences and hasn't troubled the judge; soundly beaten over C&D the last twice; new cheekpieces need to eke out more.
runners.comment: Bumper and hurdles winner, 0-3 in chases, well beaten here last twice, cheekpieces tried

runners.name: West Away
runners.spotlight: Two-time hurdles winner; extended chase record to 0-7 when a 14.5l third of 9 over C&D on debut for this yard last month but may have needed that after 208 days off and could get closer now; rated 114 and in the mix.
runners.comment: 0-7 over fences, may have needed latest when third over C&D, could get closer now

races.race_name: Wexfordraces.ie Handicap Chase

runners.name: Leave In Secret
runners.spotlight: Back to form with fine effort under positive ride in big field at Galway on latest; has gone well over this C&D before so obvious chance off the same mark as last time.
runners.comment: Back to form at Galway, same mark here, has run well over C&D before, big chance

runners.name: Freddie Robdal
runners.spotlight: 3-22 over fences (including a 2m win here); back from 114 days off with respectable run at Downpatrick on latest (19.5f, good); sharper for that but probably not much margin for error off current mark.
runners.comment: Course winner, respectable run after break latest, no margin for error off this mark

runners.name: Oneforgonzo
runners.spotlight: Landed a handicap chase at Killarney in May (20.5f, gd-yld) off 7lb lower; failed to follow up off revised mark at Limerick and soundly beaten off higher hurdles mark at Galway on latest; a bit to prove for now.
runners.comment: Won off 7lb lower at Killarney in May, beaten off revised mark at Limerick, bit to prove

runners.name: Following Orders
runners.spotlight: Maiden showed ability in a couple of maiden hurdles but has failed to complete in two of his four starts in 2026; pulled up in first-time blinkers at Killarney latest; blinkers tried now.
runners.comment: Failed to complete in two of four starts in 2026, pulled up latest, blinkers tried now

runners.name: Beggars Rock
runners.spotlight: 1-9 over fences; hasn't really fired in 2026 and failed to exploit lower hurdles mark at Galway on latest when 28-1; needs to rediscover best.
runners.comment: 1-9 over fences, form this year not his best, failed to exploit lower hurdles mark latest

runners.name: Temptationinmilan
runners.spotlight: Is 18lb lower than when winning at Navan in February 2023 but he's lost his way and no signs of a revival when pulled up at Killarney on latest.
runners.comment: 18lb lower than last win but has lost way, pulled up at Killarney last time

runners.name: Centreofattention
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner; yet to show much over fences and his second here on latest was an extremely remote one (beaten 70l, just two finished); cheekpieces go on now for handicap chase debut; not easy to make a case for.
runners.comment: Bumper winner, poor second here latest, cheekpieces on for h'cap chase debut

runners.name: Avec Espoir
runners.spotlight: Veteran is a four-time chase winner (including over C&D) but hasn't won since 2024 and badly out of form when last seen at Killarney in October; entitled to need this and best watched.
runners.comment: Veteran, C&D winner but no joy since 2024, out of form last year, may need this run

races.race_name: Poolcourt Engineering Handicap Chase

runners.name: Ceroc
runners.spotlight: Gained first chase win over C&D (good) just 17 days ago, bolting up by 11l; on the face of it, a 6lb rise for that looks a shade lenient but it probably wasn't the strongest of races and this is tougher; likes it here but needs to improve again to follow up.
runners.comment: Up 6lb for 11l win here on latest, this is a tougher race, more needed to follow up

runners.name: Jacovec Cavern
runners.spotlight: Both wins for this yard have come on rain softened ground at around 2m4f; had been in decent form over timber before pulling up at Killarney last time (2m7f, good, jockey reported never travelled); may need softer ground.
runners.comment: Never travelled on latest when PU at Killarney over hurdles, rain would boost chance

runners.name: Teenage Kiss
runners.spotlight: In fine form over hurdles this year (won over 3m here in May) and very encouraging start to chasing career when beaten a neck behind Rue Taylor here on latest; nudged up 4lb but likely to be bang there again.
runners.comment: Course winner over timber, a neck behind Rue Taylor here latest, up 4lb, go well again

runners.name: Rockonliam
runners.spotlight: Arrives in terrific form, winning over hurdles at Listowel in late May and then scoring in a beginners' over 19.5f (good) here on his chase debut; he's a brother of Scottish National winner Captain Cody so should stay this far and his opening mark looks workable; should go well on handicap chase debut.
runners.comment: Won 19.5f beginners' here latest, bred to stay this far, opening mark workable, go well

runners.name: Duty Bound
runners.spotlight: Course winner over 19.5f in 2024 off 5lb lower; won a couple of handicap hurdles last year but out of form so far in 2026 and well held behind two of these over C&D on latest; others appeal more.
runners.comment: Course winner in 2024, out of form this year so far, well held behind two of these latest
runners.owner: Desmond O'Brien & John T O'Neill & J P Flavin

runners.name: Rue Taylor
runners.spotlight: Two-time hurdles winner got off the mark over fences here on latest (2m7f, good), beating Teenage Kiss by a neck off 105; 7lb rise mostly negated by rider's claim; this is a deeper race so further improvement will be required, but that's not impossible; stamina assured.
runners.comment: Up 7lb for 2m7f win here latest, this harder but may be more to come, stamina assured

runners.name: Sphagnum
runners.spotlight: Has gone the wrong way since winning the 2024 Cork National; signs of a revival over hurdles at Sligo on penultimate but didn't build on it back there on latest; remains 5lb above his last chase win and failed to complete last two chase starts.
runners.comment: Lost form after Cork National win, remains 5lb above that success, others preferred

races.race_name: BOYLE Sports Handicap Chase

runners.name: Rightfolksplease
runners.spotlight: Sent off at just 9-2 on return from mammoth absence in a handicap hurdle here 16 days ago (16.5f, good) and denied only by a neck; capable off this mark over fences but the 'bounce' factor has to be a concern and has fallen both previous chase runs at this venue.
runners.comment: Fine run over hurdles after huge layoff, capable off this mark but 'bounce' factor a worry

runners.name: Lady Doyanne
runners.spotlight: Point and hurdles winner (here) ran a nice race over C&D on latest under a positive ride, beaten just 2.25l by Ballybrittas on her second chase start; the third from that race has since run well at Galway so she is interesting off just 2lb higher.
runners.comment: Course winner over timber, fine run over C&D latest, claims off just 2lb higher

runners.name: Solsbury Hill
runners.spotlight: Won a beginners chase at Roscommon in good style last summer (16.5f, yielding); hasn't fired since and unseated at the first on seasonal return here in June; others make more appeal.
runners.comment: Lost form since beginners' win last summer, unseated at the first here in June

runners.name: Ballybrittas
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the eighth attempt over fences over this C&D 17 days ago, beating Lady Doyanne by 2.25l; 6lb higher now but some of that is negated by his rider's claim; should be on the premises again.
runners.comment: C&D win on latest, up 6lb but rider's claim negates some of that, on the premises again

runners.name: Bynx
