runners.spotlight: Versatile mare scored on the Flat at Tramore (2m, good) on her latest outing; her sole win from five chase starts came in in this race last year (good) off 107; 5lb higher here but arrives in form and can't be discounted.
runners.comment: Won this last year off 5lb lower, Tramore Flat win latest, in form and can't discount

runners.name: Ned In The Park
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler is 0-2 over fences but shaped like his turn was near here on penultimate when chasing home Rockonliam (19.5f, good); hampered and unseated at the first on latest at Galway; chance, but might prefer more of a stamina test.
runners.comment: 0-2 over fences, good run over 19.5f here on penultimate, this shorter trip a query

races.race_name: Racing Again 28th August Fillies INH Flat Race

runners.name: Honey Buck's
runners.spotlight: Nathaniel filly out of unraced half-sister to top-class staying hurdler Big Buck's; shaped with plenty of promise when a 1.25l second to Hilly Filly at Cork on debut 29 days ago, hitting the front a furlong and a half out before being worn down; signs of greenness that day and bound to step forward; big chance.
runners.comment: Shaped with plenty of promise when second on debut, green; will improve; leading chance

runners.name: Alicious
runners.spotlight: Pastorius filly cost 25,000Euros as a 3yo; half-sister to French winners West Coast (2m1f hurdle) and Magic Flight (2m2f hurdle/2m3f chase); dam French 1m2f winner, sister to winners Head Lad (2m1f hurdle) and Honourmission (2m4f hurdle/2m5f chase); makes debut for in-form yard with outstanding record in bumpers; obvious leading player.
runners.comment: Half-sister to two French hurdle/chase winners; dam French 1m2f winner; debut for top yard

runners.name: Dancing Symbol
runners.spotlight: Feel Like Dancing filly; dam point winner, half-sister to bumper/2m hurdle winner On The Wild Side, out of useful 2m hurdle winner; yard 3-11 in bumpers this season and their runners always command respect; market clues can help; yard won this last year.
runners.comment: Dam point winner, half-sister to bumper/hurdle winner; yard great strike-rate in bumpers

runners.name: Hee Hiles
runners.spotlight: Yeats fily; half-sister to winners Friary Road (bumper/2m hurdle), Hardwired (2m1f-2m7f hurdle/chase) and Be Fierce (1m7f chase/2m hurdle); dam bumper (inc Listed) and 2m/2m2f hurdle winner; from family yard knows well; dam and half-brother are bumper winners; market can guide on debut.
runners.comment: Yeats filly from family yard has done very well with; half-brother and dam won a bumper

runners.name: Misses Woo
runners.spotlight: 2,000euro 3yo; half-sister to useful 2m4f-2m7f hurdle/chase winner Lord Of Thunder; dam unraced sister to 2m4f-2m6f hurdle/chase winner The Caddy Rose, out of unraced half-sister to Cheltenham Gold Cup third Harbour Pilot; pulled up on sole point-to-point start; big ask.
runners.comment: Half-sister to useful hurdle/chase winner; pulled up on sole point-to-point start in May

runners.name: Sierra's Dream
runners.spotlight: Sister to 1m4f winner Celtic Druid (inc AW; RPR 73), half-sister to 7f/1m winner Lady Scathach (86); dam well beaten 5f-1m2f (33), half-sister to 6f winner Charley's Aunt, out of 7f winning half-sister to 6f 2yo Listed winner Miss Beabea; bred to have a chance on the Flat; probably a big ask.
runners.comment: Sister to 1m4f winner (RPR 73), half-sister to 7f/1m winner (86); likely a big ask
runners.owner: Miss Ciara McGee & Ms Denise McCourt

runners.name: The Lodge Lane
runners.spotlight: Maxios filly; unraced dam closely related to bumper winner Dramalarma Lucy, out of unraced sister to Grade 1 bumper winner Lovethehigherlaw; a pedigree which appeals to this sphere for trainer who does well with small string.
runners.comment: Dam related to bumper winner, out sister to G1 winner; yard does well with small string

runners.name: Highland Call
runners.spotlight: Sister to smart 1m4f winner Highland Bling; will improve for experience on debut 29 days ago, beaten 25l into eighth at Cork; well-held by Honey Bucks on that form.
runners.comment: Should improve for debut 29 days ago but well-held by Honey Bucks that day

races.race_name: Watch Racing TV In Stunning HD Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Yimmna
runners.spotlight: No match for useful rival when second of three in tactical race at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) in June, her second start, and remains tricky to weigh up but she represents a top stable and there's a good chance she'll play a significant role.
runners.comment: Tricky to weigh up after her second of three at Newmarket but represents a top stable

runners.name: Raggaas
runners.spotlight: In the frame all three starts, albeit no match for clear winner when second of four at Salisbury (1m, good to firm) a fortnight ago; vulnerable to anything useful but a leading contender if coping with this drop in trip.
runners.comment: Vulnerable to anything useful but has made the frame on all three starts; drops in trip

runners.name: Vastern
runners.spotlight: Disappointing favourite when well-held third of six at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago but his debut second at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) a fortnight earlier was quite promising, and he still has plenty of scope to build on that.
runners.comment: Disappointing favourite on second start but his debut was promising; shortlisted

runners.name: Khanimambo
runners.spotlight: Sixth foal; half-brother to 5f winner Modular Magic (RPR 86); dam 5f 2yo winner (72), half-sister to prolific 6f-1m winner Al's Memory and Graded-placed 5f 2yo winner Cloneylass; one of two newcomers from the Barron stable; riding arrangements suggest he may by the second string.
runners.comment: Half-brother to fairly useful 5f winner Modular Magic; stable runs two newcomers in this

runners.name: Suntino Lady
runners.spotlight: Fifth foal; dam 5f/6f 2yo winner (RPR 83), closely related to prolific 7f-10.6f winner Reckless Lad; one of two newcomers from the stable; market support will bring her into the equation.
runners.comment: First foal from a winning sprinter; market support will bring her into the equation

runners.name: War And Love
runners.spotlight: Made the frame on five of her seven starts but was well held when fourth of nine in Class 6 handicap at Newcastle (7f, AW; first-time cheekpieces) last week and another minor role may be her best hope here.
runners.comment: Fourth in Class 6 handicaps on last two outings; another minor role may be her best hope

runners.name: Bowie Lass
runners.spotlight: Out of a Listed 6f winner but was unable to land a significant blow when 80-1 for debut over C&D (good to firm) ten days ago.
runners.comment: Unable to land a significant blow when 80-1 for debut over C&D ten days ago

runners.name: Magic Lady Mae
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in two low-grade 7f handicaps for new stable this summer and now 0-8; can't be recommended on these terms.
runners.comment: Well beaten in two low-grade 7f handicaps for new stable this summer and now 0-8
runners.owner: Dr M Voikhansky & Mrs S Voikhanskaya

races.race_name: Celebrate The Life Of Ann Allport Handicap

runners.name: Park Lane Penny
runners.spotlight: Just held on from Here Comes Louie to open account in Thirsk classified (1m, good to firm) last month, her fifth start; this race is a bit stronger but she's open to further progress; respected.
runners.comment: Just held on to win Thirsk classified last month and remains lightly raced; respected

runners.name: Saxon Grace
runners.spotlight: 14-race maiden; campaign mainly as a sprinter but, having been upped in trip, caught the eye finishing strongly from the rear for a close third at Hamilton (1m1f, good) a week ago; still on good mark after 2lb nudge; looks close to a breakthrough.
runners.comment: Caught the eye finishing strongly to go close at Hamilton last week; major player

runners.name: Dalamara
runners.spotlight: Won on nursery debut at Newcastle (1m, AW) in December and returned from break with two pretty good turf runs in the spring (both 1m); below that form twice since (1m2f/1m4f) but may benefit from this drop back in trip.
runners.comment: Below form on last two starts (1m2f/1m4f) but this drop back to 1m ought to suit

runners.name: Here Comes Louie
runners.spotlight: A maiden after six runs but lost out only by a short head to Park Lane Penny in Thirsk classified (1m, good to firm) last month and also finished second in Southwell handicap (1m, AW) on Thursday; likely contender.
runners.comment: Runner-up on last two starts (classified/handicap); likely contender again

runners.name: Diamond Aura
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden; close second off today's mark at Leicester last month, her final start for Hugo Palmer, but failed to build upon an encouraging stable debut when last of seven at Ripon (also 1m2f, good to firm) 12 days ago; drops back in trip here.
runners.comment: Failed to build upon encouraging stable debut when last of seven at Ripon recently

runners.name: Ice Show
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in modest AW maiden six weeks ago (9.4f) but showed minor promise on her first three starts (7f-1m1f) and now makes her handicap debut at a lowly level; market may guide.
runners.comment: Well beaten in modest maiden last time but makes handicap debut at lowly level

runners.name: Miss Potomac
runners.spotlight: Down the field on both 2yo starts (6f/7.4f) and showed only minor promise when fifth of seven in Southwell novice (1m, AW) on latest outing in March but remains unexposed and improvement is possible in handicaps.
runners.comment: Absent since low-key AW novice run in March but remains unexposed; handicap debut

runners.name: Itszaboy
runners.spotlight: Beaten over 9l when fifth of seven at Ripon (1m, good) on Monday and has now been unplaced all seven starts; needs to find improvement from somewhere.
runners.comment: Unplaced all seven starts and needs to find improvement from somewhere

races.race_name: Marske Fabrications & Engineering Straight Mile Handicap (Straight Mile Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Frankies Dream
runners.spotlight: Placed off marks slightly higher than today's four consecutive times in May/June, the last twice at York (1m1f/1m, good); not quite at same level on last two outings but still enters calculations.
runners.comment: Both runs in July were below par but his May/June placed form gives him strong claims

runners.name: Nyman
runners.spotlight: Just a respectable fourth of seven over C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago but that run came after a short break and he's now well handicapped if judged on some of this spring's form; worth a second look.
runners.comment: Just a respectable fourth here last month but well handicapped if judged on spring form

runners.name: Welbury
runners.spotlight: Kept on well to score at Pontefract (1m, good) last month and is now 2-7; 5lb higher in a more competitive race here might still have more to offer.
runners.comment: Won at Pontefract last month and is now 2-7; up in grade here but may have more to offer

runners.name: Barley
runners.spotlight: Beaten under 1l when third of 15 at York (1m, good to firm) a fortnight ago and has now made the frame six consecutive times; holds no secrets from the handicapper but ought to give another good account.
runners.comment: Consistent 7yo who was beaten under 1l when third of 15 at York a fortnight ago

runners.name: Amidst The Chaos
runners.spotlight: Clearcut winner in first-time cheekpieces at Pontefract (1m, good) in June and probably bettered that form when very close second at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) last month but was below form after racing too freely over C&D three weeks ago and needs to bounce back with a career best.
runners.comment: Won in new cheekpieces in June but was below form here last month; needs a new PB today

runners.name: Vince Le Prince
runners.spotlight: Gained all five wins over 7f; went close over that trip in Class 6 event at regular haunt Catterick (good to firm) last month but went up 2lb for that and looks vulnerable over 1m in this stronger race.
runners.comment: Ran well in recent 7f Class 6 race but that's his best trip; looks vulnerable here

runners.name: Paladin
runners.spotlight: Caused 33-1 surprise on stable debut at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW) in January and rebounded from lesser effort when second over the straight 1m at Ascot (good to firm; winner followed up soon afterwards) last month; considered.
runners.comment: Creditable second to next-time-out winner over Ascot's straight 1m last month; considered

runners.name: Harry The Rogue
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 5yo; started off for current stable with two good runs over 1m in the spring but has suffered a worrying slump in form since and needs to be perked up by the addition of a visor.
runners.comment: Started off for stable with two good runs in the spring but form has slumped since

runners.name: Illy's Roo
runners.spotlight: Showed career-best form when scoring at York (1m, good to firm) last month and was denied clear run in closing stages when very respectable fifth at Ascot (7f, good to firm) a fortnight later; still unexposed over 1m and remains very much of interest.
runners.comment: Career-best form when winning at York (1m) last month; also ran well at Ascot (7f) latest

runners.name: Gorgeous Mr George
runners.spotlight: Slightly disappointing off this career-high mark when dropped back to 7f at Yarmouth last month but won twice over the straight 1m there (good to firm) in June and further progress is not yet out of the question.
runners.comment: Shade disappointing over 7f last time but won twice over Yarmouth's straight 1m in June

runners.name: Sea The Power
runners.spotlight: Unexposed after only five starts but finished well down the field when 66-1 for seasonal/stable debut at Haydock (1m, good) three months ago; not seen since; considered only if much stronger in the betting here.
runners.comment: Unexposed after only five runs but absent since low-key seasonal/stable debut in May

runners.name: Mr Mistoffelees
runners.spotlight: Strong traveller who sometimes flatters to deceive; close second to a recent Glorious Goodwood winner on latest turf start, at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) in June, and also ran well on AW last month but has modest 2-32 strike-rate and others appeal more for win purposes; usually wears blinkers or cheekpieces but goes only in a first-time tongue-tie here.
runners.comment: In good form but this strong traveller often flatters to deceive; not the percentage call

runners.name: Chesneys Charm
runners.spotlight: Safely held on all three starts for Grant Tuer this spring but has since been given a wind op; makes stable debut from a good mark; well worth a glance in the betting.
runners.comment: Out of form this spring but on good mark for stable debut and has been given a wind op
runners.owner: James Paul Services To Industry Ltd

runners.name: Capital Guarantee
runners.spotlight: Not quite at best this season but exploited some help from the handicapper when winning narrowly at Thirsk (1m, good to firm) last month and ought to remain competitive after going back up 4lb.
runners.comment: Won off reduced mark at Thirsk last month; can remain competitive after going back up 4lb

races.race_name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap

runners.name: Spring Is Sprung
runners.spotlight: Placed three consecutive times in May-July, most recently when close second off today's mark at York (5f, good to firm); behind Democracy Dilemma when mid-pack in big field at Glorious Goodwood last week but that certainly wasn't a bad run; can make his presence felt.
runners.comment: Didn't run badly at Goodwood last week; placed three consecutive times before that

runners.name: Fidelius
runners.spotlight: 6-18 on AW but 0-10 on turf when trained by Robert Cowell; sold for 27,000gns after disappointing AW run in June; makes stable debut from a workable mark but others in this field have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Makes stable debut from a workable mark but has done all his winning on the AW

runners.name: Rosenpur
runners.spotlight: Made all off 1lb lower at Chester (6f, good) in May and wasn't beaten far on any of four subsequent starts there, the latest over 5f from a tough draw; may not be seen to quite the same effect on this straight track, though.
runners.comment: Chester regular; in good form there this season but may not be quite as potent here

runners.name: Sports Coach
runners.spotlight: Gained all three wins on Tapeta but kept on well for close second of 17 on turf at York (5f, good to firm) a fortnight ago and is respected off just 2lb higher here.
runners.comment: Gained all three wins on AW but was close second of 17 on turf at York on latest outing

runners.name: Democracy Dilemma
runners.spotlight: Free-going front-runner; no longer the force of old but ran big race when fourth of 23 at Glorious Goodwood (5f, good) last week; 1lb lower here and could be hard to catch if in similar form again.
runners.comment: Free-going front-runner; ran big race when fourth of 23 at Glorious Goodwood last week

races.race_name: Market Cross Jewellers Classified Stakes

runners.name: Gwen Tennyson
runners.spotlight: A maiden after eight starts but attracted some market support before a back-to-form second in Catterick handicap (5f, good to firm) on Tuesday; will pose a potent threat if in similar mood again here.
runners.comment: Returned to form with close second at Catterick on Tuesday; high on the list

runners.name: Ellie's de Vega
runners.spotlight: Consistent in handicaps for Noel Wilson this year, signing off for him with a second at Newcastle (5f, AW) a fortnight ago; dips into this basement grade for stable debut (same owners) and has the services of Cieren Fallon; good chance.
runners.comment: Consistent in handicaps for Noel Wilson this year; player in this grade on stable debut

runners.name: Up The Monk
runners.spotlight: Dual 6f AW winner; returned from break with low-key turf run over that trip last month and has never run over 5f before; swaps visor (worn for last six races) for refitted cheekpieces; others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Dual 6f AW winner; returned to turf with low-key run last month; first 5f attempt today

runners.name: Let's Go Hugo
runners.spotlight: Lost his way in the spring but, following a two-month break, was placed off reduced mark at Newcastle (5f, AW) a fortnight ago; today's return to turf is probably not ideal but he still enters calculations on first dip into this basement grade.
runners.comment: Placed on AW last month; this return to turf is not ideal; still enters calculations

runners.name: Pinpoint
runners.spotlight: Runner-up off her basement handicap mark on stable debut at Wetherby (5.5f, good to firm) in June and also ran well when fourth at Beverley (5f, good to firm) last month; not really favoured by today's weights but can give another good account.
runners.comment: Made the frame in handicaps on both starts for new stable; can give another good account

runners.name: Doralee
runners.spotlight: Won this race a year ago and has made the frame in handicaps on her last four appearances; about 1l behind Gwen Tennyson at Catterick (5f, good to firm) on Tuesday and 2lb worse off with her today but still likely to be in the shake-up.
runners.comment: Won this in 2025 and has made the frame in her last four handicaps; in the mix again

runners.name: Bust A Moon
runners.spotlight: Belied 50-1 odds and put in fairly good front-running shift when third of six in this grade at Wolverhampton (5f, AW; refitted hood) last week, his second start for Derek Shaw; also suited by turf but others appeal more all the same.
runners.comment: Belied 50-1 odds when third of six in this grade on AW last week but others look stronger

races.race_name: Remembering Christine And Colin Brown Handicap

runners.name: Spooky Wooky
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden; ought to have coped better with the soft ground when beaten 55l on final start last season and was again tailed off when reappearing on AW last month; now sports first-time tongue-tie and visor; others have much less to prove.
runners.comment: Seven-race maiden; tailed off on seasonal debut; tongue-tie and visor now added

runners.name: Billy Bathgate
runners.spotlight: Beat his three rivals fairly comfortably when back on turf here (2m, good to firm) three weeks ago and is evidently in good nick but a recent 4lb rise might be enough to leave this 10yo vulnerable.
runners.comment: Recent small-field winner here (2m); 4lb rise might leave this 10yo vulnerable, though

runners.name: Dubai Venture
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner over 1m4f, most recently at Pontefract (good) last month; bumped into very well-handicapped rival when second at Thirsk (1m4f, good to firm) a fortnight ago and looks interesting over this new trip.
runners.comment: In good form over 1m4f last month and looks interesting over his new trip

runners.name: Saratoga Gold
runners.spotlight: Began this season with two good efforts in May (1m4f/1m6f) and is well handicapped if judged on those but was soundly beaten on last two starts and comes here with a point to prove; blinkered last time; usual cheekpieces now refitted.
runners.comment: Well handicapped on his two runs in May but well beaten twice since

runners.name: Buxted Reel
runners.spotlight: Not seen on the Flat since narrow AW win over this trip in October but placed twice over hurdles in recent weeks; probably won't be far away.
runners.comment: Won latest Flat start in October and placed twice over hurdles in recent weeks; in the mix

runners.name: Galistra
runners.spotlight: Struggled on last month's handicap debut at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) and didn't achieve a great deal when seventh of ten in slowly run race at Southwell (1m3f, AW) soon afterwards; remains lightly raced but needs to take a big step forward over this new trip.
runners.comment: Remains lightly raced but needs to take a big step forward over this new trip

runners.name: Time Twister
runners.spotlight: Yet to be placed after six starts but made satisfactory seasonal debut over 1m2f last month and could quite plausibly be seen to better effect over this longer trip; well worth keeping an eye on in the betting.
runners.comment: 0-6 but made satisfactory seasonal debut over 1m2f and is now hiked up in trip; a possible

runners.name: Newport
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner since joining Iain Jardine in the autumn and a very respectable fourth of 13 on the Flat at York (2m, good to firm) a fortnight ago; contests this easier race from the same mark; must be considered.
runners.comment: Drops in grade after very respectable fourth of 13 off this mark at York last month

runners.name: Nanny Park
runners.spotlight: Came good for current stable at fifth attempt, in tactical four-runner race at Doncaster (extended 1m6f, good to firm) last month but was behind Newport when down the field at York a fortnight later; others have more convincing profiles.
runners.comment: Best three rivals in tactical race last month but well held since; others preferred

races.race_name: Watch Race Replays On Racing TV Handicap

runners.name: Space Bear
runners.spotlight: Flopped at York two weeks ago but that was after two placed efforts including a near-miss at Thirsk (6f, good) in June; still looks feasibly treated on that form and has possibilities if she can bounce back.
runners.comment: Flopped at York last time but she's player if she can bounce back near best

runners.name: Masaban
runners.spotlight: Landed the odds with an emphatic win on handicap debut here (1m, good) in May; placed in two of his three runs since including when runner-up under a prominent ride at Catterick (7f, good to firm) last month; now returns to sprinting but he's still lightly raced and could make another bold bid.
runners.comment: Runner-up at Catterick (7f, good to firm) last time and he's respected back at this trip

runners.name: French Affair
runners.spotlight: Record of 1-13 for Richard Hannon but he made a bright start for his new yard when beating 25 rivals at Goodwood (6f, good to firm) last Wednesday; up 4lb for that narrow success but he did well to overcome trouble and is a major player again on this drop back in grade.
runners.comment: Beat 25 rivals on his stable debut at Goodwood last week; big player again off 4lb higher

runners.name: Houndhill
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-5 on AW when beating Brave Traveller at Newcastle (5f) last Friday; 2lb lower back on turf but he's 0-7 in this sphere and has form figures of 68008 on grass this season; not hard to have reservations.
runners.comment: Won off 2lb higher on AW last Friday but he has form figures of 68008 on turf this season
runners.owner: J Raybould N Skinner D Jenkins

runners.name: Brave Traveller
runners.spotlight: Won at Newcastle (6f, AW) last December and he's been placed there in three of his last four runs including when runner-up over 5f last week; on same mark here but his best efforts have been on Tapeta and he's been well held in last four turf runs; some risks attached.
runners.comment: His best form has been on Tapeta at Newcastle and he has bit to prove back on turf

runners.name: Bleep Test
runners.spotlight: Won a C&D maiden (good to firm) last May but she's struggled since switched to handicaps and has failed to beat a rival in her last two runs; mark is tumbling but she needs a major revival on this drop back in trip; tongue-tie is removed and blinkers are now tried.
runners.comment: C&D maiden winner but she's struggled in four handicaps and needs a major revival

runners.name: Bye Law
runners.spotlight: Won an Ayr maiden (6f, good) and a C&D novice (good to firm) last August; some fair runs in handicaps this season, but he's not easy to predict and was beaten a long way with cheekpieces added at York last time; stablemate of Bleep Test.
runners.comment: On workable mark but he's not easy to predict and was beaten a long way at York last time

races.race_name: Well Of Moate Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Facile Ocean
runners.spotlight: Placed three times in maiden hurdles at this venue and probably his best effort was when runner-up in a 2m3f contest two weeks ago; worth dropping back in trip and sets a fair standard; likely to be the one to beat.
runners.comment: Placed three times in maiden hurdles at this venue; likely to be the one to beat

runners.name: Captain Hanley
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in maiden hurdles at Clonmel in May and Punchestown in June; failed to match that form at Wexford last month; more like it when fourth in a Flat handicap at Tramore four days later.
runners.comment: Runner-up in maiden hurdles in May and June; fourth in a Flat handicap at Tramore latest

runners.name: Whoyougonnacall
runners.spotlight: In contention when stumbling and falling two out on hurdling debut at Clonmel; still looked raw when third at Ballinrobe last month; should contend.
runners.comment: Still looked raw when third at Ballinrobe last month; should contend

runners.name: First Ascent
runners.spotlight: Touched off in a Down Royal Flat maiden last year; might have been a bit closer at Ballinrobe last time but for a mistake two out; should not be too far away.
runners.comment: Might have been a bit closer at Ballinrobe last time but for a mistake two out; claims

runners.name: Calamint
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m Naas handicap on yielding two years ago; a couple of solid runs in Flat handicaps of late, including when third in a 1m1f Ballinrobe contest in May; hurdling debut here.
runners.comment: Flat winner; third in a 1m1f Ballinrobe Flat handicap in May; hurdling debut here

runners.name: Digby Bridge
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; brother to 1m4f/13.5f winner Golden Bugle (RPR 90), half-brother to 1m winner Golden Love (59); dam 1m winner (inc Listed; 107), half-sister to 2,000 Guineas winner Footstepsinthesand and 6f 2yo Group 1 winner Pedro The Great; good Flat pedigree; certainly of interest on his track debut.
runners.comment: Good Flat pedigree; certainly of interest on his track debut

runners.name: Not In A Hurry
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam useful 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase winner, half-sister to useful 2m-2m4f hurdle winner Soul Emotion, out of French 2m1f hurdle/chase winning half-sister to useful 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase winner Helium; home-bred newcomer best watched on this occasion.
runners.comment: Home-bred newcomer best watched on this occasion

runners.name: Rose Mountain
runners.spotlight: Nothing to recommend her on based on three moderate runs.
runners.comment: Nothing to recommend her on based on three moderate runs

runners.name: Anns Getaway
runners.spotlight: Close third on the second of two point-to-points in March; probably best watched this time.
runners.comment: Close third on the second of two point-to-points in March; probably best watched this time

runners.name: Through The Storm
runners.spotlight: Off the track for 13 months after a reasonably promising debut in a Hereford bumper; well beaten in a Naas bumper in January when last seen; worth watchng though on his hurdles bow.
runners.comment: Well beaten in a Naas bumper in January when last seen; worth watchng on his hurdles bow

runners.name: Earthwatch
runners.spotlight: Sandown 1m handicap winner for William Haggas; seems to be improving gradually over hurdles; decent fourth over C&D two weeks ago; non-runner 4.45 Wexford Friday
runners.comment: Seems to be improving gradually over hurdles; decent fourth over C&D two weeks ago

races.race_name: Kieran Kelly Memorial Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Blue Reed
runners.spotlight: Went up 10lb for winning a 2m3f handicap hurdle here in May; has to bounce back from an ordinary effort at Killarney last month over this shorter trip but the booking of Jack Kennedy an obvious plus.
runners.comment: Has to bounce back from an ordinary effort at Killarney last month over this shorter trip

runners.name: Surviving Murmansk
runners.spotlight: Won a handicap hurdle at Tramore a year ago; right back to form when runner-up in a handicap hurdle at Cork on Monday; suited by a sharp, left-handed track and will go close if coming here in the same form.
runners.comment: Runner-up in a handicap hurdle at Cork on Monday; suited by a sharp, left-handed track

runners.name: Liceo
runners.spotlight: Three-time Flat winner yet to score over flights; best recent effort when a close third in a 2m Tramore handicap hurdle in May; needs to bounce back from an ordinary effort in a Downpatrick maiden hurdle last month.
runners.comment: Best recent effort when a close third in a 2m Tramore handicap hurdle in May; claims

runners.name: Corkbeg
runners.spotlight: Dual winner over flights, most recently off 88 at Wexford three years ago; didn't run badly after a nine month break at Killarney last month and should come on for that.
runners.comment: Didn't run badly after a nine month break at Killarney last month; should come on for that

runners.name: Walk Win
runners.spotlight: Close third in a handicap hurdle over C&D in May; ran to a similar level in a more competitive contest at Roscommon last month; one for the short list.
runners.comment: Good run in a more competitive contest at Roscommon last month; one for the short list

runners.name: Folk Warrior
runners.spotlight: Three runs down the field in juvenile maiden hurdles last season; has run to his level in Flat handicaps since; interesting mark and an attractive jockey booking so could well have a bit to offer here.
runners.comment: Interesting mark and an attractive jockey booking so could well have a bit to offer here

runners.name: Syosset
runners.spotlight: Winner on the Flat and very consistent of late over hurdles, most recently finishing second to a front-running winner at Cork on Monday; the one to beat if able to reproduce that.
runners.comment: Second to a front-running winner at Cork on Monday; the one to beat if able to reproduce

runners.name: Valsorpresa
runners.spotlight: Downpatrick maiden hurdle winner two years ago; coming down the handicap but well beaten in a pair of handicap hurdles at Ballinrobe; others preferred.
runners.comment: Coming down the handicap but well beaten in a pair of handicap hurdles at Ballinrobe

runners.name: Ferdia
runners.spotlight: On a long losing run and needs to improve markedly on recent efforts over fences; latest efforts over hurdles are no more encouraging.
runners.comment: On a long losing run and needs to improve markedly on recent chase and hurdle efforts

runners.name: Kinski
runners.spotlight: Little impact for Pat Kelly in bumpers and maiden hurdles two years ago; ran out in a point-to-point in April; best watched on his stable debut.
runners.comment: Ran out in a point-to-point in April; best watched on his stable debut

runners.name: Ardgillan
runners.spotlight: Beaten out of sight in three maiden hurdles at the end of last year; off since December and hard to fancy on the evidence so far.
runners.comment: Off since December and hard to fancy on the evidence so far

runners.name: Bravemans Bounce
runners.spotlight: Three maiden runs don't give much encouragement, but could improve now handicapping.
runners.comment: Three maiden runs don't give much encouragement, but could improve now handicapping

runners.name: Convincing
runners.spotlight: Three runs in maiden hurdles over the winter were nott devoid of promise; decent effort in first-time blinkers in a 1m handicap at Naas last month; cheekpieces tried for the first time over hurdles today; could go well at a big price.
runners.comment: Cheekpieces tried for the first time over hurdles today; could go well at a big price

races.race_name: Bernard Kenny Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Tyson Fury
runners.spotlight: Four-time Flat winner; useful maiden hurdle form including when a staying third in a 2m maiden hurdle at Galway last week; this trip should suit and he probably does not have to improve to land this.
runners.comment: Good Galway run; trip should suit and he probably does not have to improve to land this

runners.name: Cooladdi
runners.spotlight: Chased home a clear winner in 2m5f Roscommon maiden a year ago and best effort since in similar contest early this month, tracking leaders and every chance when falling two out; definite player.
runners.comment: Tracked leaders and every chance when falling two out at Roscommon; definite player

runners.name: Mont Star
runners.spotlight: French improve; off for nine months before finishing second in a maiden hurdle at Cork last month; has more to find but every chance that there is more improvement to come; tongue-tie applied here.
runners.comment: Cork runner-up last month; every chance that there is more improvement to come
runners.owner: Mark E Phelan & Paul W Phelan

runners.name: Mystery Decision
runners.spotlight: Was weakening when fell two out on sole point start; tongue-tie on for rules debut; best watched.
runners.comment: Was weakening when fell two out on sole point start; tongue-tie on for rules debut

runners.name: Marilyns Poet
runners.spotlight: Third foal; dam maiden Flat/hurdles, out of Italian Listed-placed 1m-1m2f winner; another debutante that is best watched.
runners.comment: Another debutante that is best watched

runners.name: Master Sydney
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner last summer; mostly quite ordinary Flat form since; ran well for much of the way in a Cork maiden hurdle on Monday; more needed here; one of two runners for the stable.
runners.comment: Ran well for much of the way in a Cork maiden hurdle on Monday; more needed here

runners.name: Back Swath
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam unplaced bumper/2m-2m7f hurdles, half-sister to useful winners Victor Hewgo (2m4f-3m hurdle/chase), Crowning Jewel (2m3f-2m6f hurdle) and Sultans Pride (2m7f-3m2f hurdle); bred for stamina and best watched on his somewhat belated debut.
runners.comment: Bred for stamina and best watched on his somewhat belated debut

runners.name: Charles The Bold
runners.spotlight: Finally won a point-to-point in April at the 12th time of asking; stable in good form but this one is best watched.
runners.comment: Finally won his point-to-point in April; stable in good form but this one is best watched

runners.name: Blue Johnl
runners.spotlight: No impression on his hurdles debut over C&D last month; should improve for that but an unlikely player here.
runners.comment: No impression on his hurdles debut over C&D last month; should improve for that

runners.name: Howaya Codge
runners.spotlight: First foal; by a useful sire; dam soundly beaten in 2m hurdles, out of 2m-2m4f hurdle winner; likely one to watch this time.
runners.comment: First foal; by a useful sire; likely one to watch this time

runners.name: Phyllis Rodda
runners.spotlight: Failed to complete in either point-to-point; jumped poorly on her hurdles debut at Ballinrobe; others preferred.
runners.comment: Jumped poorly on her hurdles debut at Ballinrobe; others preferred

runners.name: Mahler's Best
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in twop starts for Gordon Elliott last year; best watched on his stable debut.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in twop starts for Gordon Elliott last year; best watched on stable debut

runners.name: Forlio
runners.spotlight: Three-time Flat winner, going up 11lb for a convincing success in a 1m4f handicap at Tramore last month; may have gone as far as he can on the Flat off his new mark and a good time to go back hurdling; claims on his third in a Punchestown maiden hurdle in June; one of two runners for the stable.
runners.comment: Now back hurdling; claims on his third in a Punchestown maiden hurdle in June

races.race_name: Joe Cooney Memorial Hurdle

runners.name: Pets Georgina
runners.spotlight: Stands out here as an improving mare; followed up a Sligo bumper success by easily landing a staying mares maiden hurdle at Killarney next month; much deeper waters here but no surprise should she be able to acquit herself well.
runners.comment: Much deeper waters here but no surprise should she be able to acquit herself well

runners.name: Rocky's Diamond
runners.spotlight: Enjoyed a fine hurdles campaign in 24-25, winning a Grade 3 at Gowran and finishing fourth in the Stayers' Hurdle at Cheltenham; winning debut over fences at Galway last September before things went a little pear-shaped; reverts back to hurdles here and at his best he would be very hard to oppose; whether he can produce his best is not so certain.
runners.comment: Reverts back to hurdles here and at his best he would be very hard to oppose

runners.name: Rememberwhat
runners.spotlight: Showed ability in a 2m bumper here in June before a poor effort at Downpatrick; totally different test here on his hurdles debut and very hard to see him playing a part.
runners.comment: Totally different test here on his hurdles debut and very hard to see him playing a part

runners.name: Drumgill
runners.spotlight: Seven-time winner over hurdles and fences; won a Listed handicap chase over 2m1f at Fairyhouse in November, but it's been all downhill since over a variety of trips; first run over hurdles since October.
runners.comment: All downhill since November over a variety of trips; first run over hurdles since October

runners.name: Olympic Man
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler-chaser for Willie Mullins; good fifth in the Kim Muir on his stable debut in March; well beaten in the Midlands National here last month on his latest start; has a similar mark over hurdles and a very interesting runner at his best.
runners.comment: Has a similar mark over hurdles to fences and a very interesting runner at his best

races.race_name: Smiddys Pub Mullingar Handicap Chase

runners.name: Zolpharine
runners.spotlight: Was a comfortable winner over fences at Limerick and hurdles at Tramore on last two starts in May; is now 12lb higher in this sphere but has to be feared if coming here in similar form.
runners.comment: 12lb higher after his Limerick win but has to be feared if coming here in similar form

runners.name: Anodandawink
runners.spotlight: Improving horse; followed a second in a Downpatrick beginners chase in June to easily make all in a 3m handicap chase at Wexford two weeks ago; up 10lb for that but there should be a lot more to come from him and he can follow up.
runners.comment: Up 10lb for Wexford but there should be a lot more to come from him and he can follow up

runners.name: Mistyburn
runners.spotlight: Won a handicap hurdle here in April and produced his best effort to date over fences when a staying third in a 2m6f handicap chase at Galway last week (Kings Jet well behind); stays well and should go well.
runners.comment: Best effort to date over fences at Galway last week; stays well and should go well

runners.name: The Little Yank
runners.spotlight: Might have appreciated the three month break when returning to some sort of form in a 3m1f handicap hurdle here last month; could run well but others look that bit more likely.
runners.comment: Returned to some sort of form in a 3m1f handicap hurdle here last month; could run well

runners.name: Kings Jet
runners.spotlight: Winning pointer and hunter chaser; well beaten on his only completed start this year in a 2m6f handicap chase at Galway last week.
runners.comment: Well beaten on his only completed start this year in a 2m6f handicap chase at Galway

races.race_name: KEPAK Handicap Chase

runners.name: Mickie Angel
runners.spotlight: Sole win came in heavy ground handicap hurdle last year; consistent in seven chase starts; arguably career best when beaten 11l into third by Vicar Street at Galway eight days ago; drop back in trip fine and he's going the right way; good claims.
runners.comment: Consistent over fences; career best beaten 11l in beginners lto; going the right way

runners.name: Ma Jacks Hill
runners.spotlight: Good debut over fences in May, third to two subsequent winners at Limerick; off the mark at second time of asking with Punchestown success in June, beating Jolie Jewel by 0.75l; struggled on handicap chase debut last time, however, and needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Promising start to life over fences but struggled on h'cap debut lto; bounce back needed

runners.name: Jasko Des Dames
runners.spotlight: Consistent handicap chaser who had some good runs in top handicaps last season, such as fifth in the Grand Annual and fourth in Red Rum; returned from 99 days off with fifth at Killarney 22 days ago, weakening after being tight for room in the straight; should prove sharper for that and player if so; question whether step up in trip will suit but won his beginners chase over this distance two years ago.
runners.comment: Consistent handicap chaser; should prove sharper for return at Killarney; up in trip

runners.name: Rexem
runners.spotlight: No win over fences since 2023 but is in good heart; beaten a neck at Kilbeggan (20.5, good) last month and beaten 15l into fifth in Galway Blazers eight days ago, may have made a better go of it but for being caught in a pocket between the final two fences; his third start in just over two weeks but chance if he doesn't feel the effects of that.
runners.comment: Comes here in good form; two solid efforts; chance if busy period doesn't catch up

runners.name: Grange Walk
runners.spotlight: Six-time winner, 4-38 over fences; chase mark has tumbled but good third at Ballinrobe (2m4f, good) in veterans race in May and decent run over hurdles at Sligo over inadequate trip; brought down at first at Kilbeggan last time; yard won this last two years.
runners.comment: Chase mark has tumbled but good third at Ballinrobe in May; yard won this last two years

runners.name: Ceanndana
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner, 2-10 over fences; ran to form when last seen in this sphere in November, beaten 5l into third at Down Royal (3m, good); returned from lay-off with satisfactory run over hurdles 85 days ago; versatile trip-wise and enjoys good ground; could be in the mix.
runners.comment: Versatile five-time winner; satisfactory return over hurdles 85 days ago; in the mix

runners.name: A Law Of Her Own
runners.spotlight: Useful five-time winner for Peter Fahey; changed hands for E25,000 in November but unseated at the first on stable debut at Galway eight days ago; tongue-tie and cheekpieces left off now; enjoys nice ground and definite claims.
runners.comment: Useful five-time winner; unseated at first on stable debut at Galway; headgear off now

runners.name: Intense Approach
runners.spotlight: Five-time hurdle winner, 1-5 over fences with sole win coming at Galway a year ago; been struggling since; showed up reasonably well before fading markedly at Galway eight days ago so this step back in trip could suit; needs more, though.
runners.comment: Struggled since beginners win year ago; mark sliding; drop in trip could suit; needs more

races.race_name: Connellan & Noone Solicitors LLP Longford INH Flat Race

runners.name: Inishtearaght
runners.spotlight: Green and unsuited by emphasis on speed when beaten 12l into fifth on debut at Killarney 23 days ago; looks okay form with winner going on to follow up at Galway; improvement likely and won't be far away.
runners.comment: Showed some promise beaten 12l on debut at Killarney in decent race; improvement likely

runners.name: Mr Enigma
runners.spotlight: Raced with exuberance when beaten 9l into third on debut at Bellewstown; should build on that, especially if learning to settle; progression likely and should definitely be in the mix.
runners.comment: Keen but good third on debut 35 days ago; one to beat with further progression

runners.name: Hot Rock Harry
runners.spotlight: Keen when seventh on debut at Down Royal; built on that when staying on into fifth at Bellewstown 35 days ago; held by Mr Enigma on that form but open to improvement now he's learning to settle.
runners.comment: Keen on debut, staying-on fifth last time; chance but held by Mr Enigma on that form

runners.name: Appy Ways
runners.spotlight: 23,000euros 3yo; half-sister to bumper winner Appy Getaway; dam bumper/1m7f hurdle winner, sister to useful bumper, 1m4f/1m6f Flat and 2m hurdle/chase winner Royal Alphabet, out of 7f Group 3 winner; eye-catching pedigree; market vibes need to be monitored.
runners.comment: 23,000euros 3yo; half-sister to bumper winner Appy Getaway; dam won bumper; interesting

runners.name: Confidence Within
runners.spotlight: Jet Away gelding; brother to useful 2m3f-2m5f hurdle/chase winner Reallyntruthfully, half-brother to 2m4f/3m hurdle winner Gold Smoke; dam bumper winner, half-sister to useful 2m-3m4f hurdle/chase winner Galaxy Rock; beaten 2.25l in point-to-point in May; could figure on rules debut.
runners.comment: Brother to 2m4f-2m5f hurdle/chase winner; beaten 2.25l in ptp in May; could figure

runners.name: Srah
runners.spotlight: Homebred by Rajj; beaten 31l into seventh on debut at Ballinrobe 18 days ago; needs significant improvement to be in with a winning chance.
runners.comment: Beaten 31l on debut 18 days ago; needs signicant improvement

races.race_name: A McKie Builders EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Roman Crystal
runners.spotlight: Connections declining nurseries after four defeats and her 6f form is up there in this company; should have a say.
runners.comment: Connections declining nurseries after four defeats; 6f form is up there in this company

runners.name: Ponte Carlo
runners.spotlight: May have his quirks as he carried his head awkwardly when a front-running third at Newcastle (7f, AW) and then dropped away when fitted with cheekpieces at Nottingham (6f); might be about to become frustrating.
runners.comment: Ability and quirks; now 0-5 and might be about to become frustrating

runners.name: Mick's The Boy
runners.spotlight: Showed good speed when second at Thirsk (6f) in July but he disappointed when one of the favourites at Catterick since; might be the yard's second string here.
runners.comment: Good speed when second at Thirsk but disappointed when one of the favourites at Catterick

runners.name: Beechwood Glory
runners.spotlight: Has probably performed to a similar level in both his races, Class 5 maidens at 6f; beaten under 2l at Chepstow in the latest and this isn't a strong race.
runners.comment: Beaten under 2l at Chepstow on latest start and this isn't a strong race

runners.name: Black Cuillin
runners.spotlight: Played her part in a strong gallop when a fading fourth on nursery debut at Pontefract (6f, good) and that wasn't too bad a run on reflection; could feature.
runners.comment: Played her part in a strong gallop when a fading fourth on nursery debut at Pontefract

runners.name: Redrosecastana
runners.spotlight: £16,000 breeze-up buy; sixth foal; closely related to 6f AW 2yo winner River Blackwater (RPR 64), half-brother to 1m winner Ravishing Beauty (73); dam 5f/6f 2yo winner (105); already gelded and would need to see some confidence behind him in the betting.
runners.comment: £16,000 breeze-up buy; would need to see some confidence behind him in the betting

runners.name: Flashing Star
runners.spotlight: Went off at 6-4 when only sixth on debut at Beverley where he was getting the hang of things late on, but then finished last of six at Newcastle (again over 5f); steps up in trip with a hood added and might be one for nurseries later.
runners.comment: Steps up in trip with a hood added; might be one for nurseries later
runners.owner: Ursa Major Racing, J Craggs & Partner

runners.name: Coul Blue
runners.spotlight: Slow to break and never involved when kicking off over 7f at Musselburgh (13-2) last week.
runners.comment: Slow to break and never involved when kicking off over 7f at Musselburgh (13-2) last week
runners.owner: Mrs T Burns And Rjh Ltd

runners.name: Unbeatable Fame
runners.spotlight: Minor form in both his runs, the latest last week at Thirsk; steps up from 5f.
runners.comment: Minor form in both his runs, the latest last week at Thirsk; steps up from 5f
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd

races.race_name: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap

runners.name: Keep The Gold
runners.spotlight: 0-10; pulled hard and didn't see things out when favourite for a 6f handicap here last month; now 5lb lower than for his C&D second in May so he is one to take seriously back down in distance; cheekpieces are the headgear of choice today.
runners.comment: 0-10 but has C&D form and he has dropped in the weights; more appealing than many

runners.name: Harb
runners.spotlight: 3lb lower than for his win in the corresponding event 12 months ago; he has won two 5f handicaps (AW and good) this year and wasn't beaten far in a Class 5 at Hamilton last week; considered.
runners.comment: Two 5f wins this year and 3lb lower than when winning this race last year; respected

runners.name: Startling
runners.spotlight: Down the field on her seasonal/stable debut in May but she has run well in defeat since, including when a close second over C&D 12 days ago; runs off the same mark today and she won't need much improvement for the addition of blinkers to play a leading role.
runners.comment: Threatening this summer and not beaten far over C&D 12 days ago; first-time blinkers today

runners.name: Royal Duke
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; yet to strike in 2026 but he has slipped down the weights and his latest C&D fifth was encouraging, just beginning to launch a challenge when forced to switch; each-way shout.
runners.comment: Conditions to suit and latest run can be upgraded; each-way shout

runners.name: Hi Lord
runners.spotlight: Scrambled home in a 5f handicap at Hamilton in May and has finished third in two of his three starts since, the latest over C&D last month; this is his first Class 6 run since the Hamilton win and he needs taking seriously.
runners.comment: Won Class 6 at Hamilton in May; 3rd in two of his three runs since, including C&D; chance

runners.name: Midnight Lir
runners.spotlight: Without a win since his 2yo days; he has run some sound races in Class 6 handicaps this year but needs to pull out more for the win; stable also runs Keep The Gold.
runners.comment: No win since September 2023; running okay at a low level this year but needs more to win

runners.name: Harry Mole
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden but placed in 5f handicaps on his last three starts and he remains open to further progress; one to take seriously.
runners.comment: 0-8 but placed on his last three starts and he is on an upward trajectory; shortlisted

runners.name: Summerstorms Dream
runners.spotlight: 0-11 but she has run well at this track, including when second over 6f last month; not quite so good back at 5f 12 days ago; vulnerable for win purposes once again.
runners.comment: 0-11 but has run well on this track; 6f may be preferable though

runners.name: Supremissy
runners.spotlight: Low-level novice/maiden form but she left that behind when delivering a strong finish to lead late on her handicap debut at Musselburgh (5f, good) 47 days ago; up 2lb but she still has potential and this stiffer test at the trip should suit.
runners.comment: Led late on handicap debut 47 days ago (5f, good); up 2lb but remains totally unexposed

runners.name: Falcon Queen
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden who hasn't matched her Irish forrm in four handicap runs for new stable; tumbling down the weights and could yet come good.
runners.comment: Yet to shine for this yard but handicapper is relenting; Irish form gives her claims

runners.name: Water Of Leith
runners.spotlight: Should be making a big impact off this mark and although he has been a shade underwhelming on turf this summer he has too much ability to leave out of calculations at this level.
runners.comment: Should be well treated but this year's turf form has been rather underwhelming
runners.owner: Adam Mills And Jonnie Delta Racing

runners.name: South Parade
runners.spotlight: Thrown in on last summer's best form and there were clear signs of a revival with her third of six at Musselburgh (5f, good) eight days ago; Ethan Tindall takes off a handy 5lb and she is one to be interested in.
runners.comment: Thrown in on last summer's best form; clear signs of a revival latest; likely type
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd

races.race_name: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap

runners.name: Faeberon
runners.spotlight: Produced a career best when winning in added cheekpieces at Wolverhampton (9.5f, AW) six weeks ago; that form perhaps isn't the strongest on offer but he's open to further improvement off a 2lb higher mark.
runners.comment: Career best when winning on Wolverhampton AW (9.5f) six weeks ago; now 2lb higher.

runners.name: Draupnir
runners.spotlight: 1-12; fair third over 1m1f at Hamilton three starts back but lesser efforts at York (1m6f and 1m) since; still 3lb above his winning mark and best form is at up to 1m1f; others more appealing.
runners.comment: Bit disappointing at York (1m-1m6f) lately and still 3lb above his winning mark

runners.name: Tiger
runners.spotlight: Continued his progress when drawing clear at Chester (10.5f, good) last Sunday; this is more competitive under a 5lb penalty but Ryan Kavanagh claims 3lb and this one has an obvious chance of following up.
runners.comment: Drew clear at Chester (10.5f) last Sunday; 5lb penalty but R Kavanagh claims 3lb

runners.name: Pol Roger
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner in 2024; run down late in refitted cheekpieces at Pontefract (1m2f) in June, and finished third (one place behind Mr Lincoln) over C&D next time; fast ground a plausible excuse for a lesser effort latest; runner-up in this last year.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner in 2024; third (one place behind Mr Lincoln) over C&D on penultimate start

runners.name: Phantom Shadow
runners.spotlight: Left Harry Charlton for 18,000gns; made a striking winning stable debut over C&D (good to firm) 19 days ago; hit with a 10lb rise but that form has been boosted twice since; massively respected.
runners.comment: Striking winning stable debut over C&D; up 10lb but form boosted since
runners.owner: J D Wright & Mrs S Wright

runners.name: Mayor Of Maghera
runners.spotlight: Game win at Musselburgh (1m1f, good) in June, in first-time cheekpieces; not in the same form since though and stamina not conclusive over 1m2f; better candidates to be found elsewhere.
runners.comment: Won in added cheekpieces at Musselburgh (1m1f) in June but not in the same form since

runners.name: Geo
runners.spotlight: Consistent since winning by a nose over 1m (good to firm; off 5lb lower) in May but lacked the pace to figure when third to a progressive winner over C&D 12 days ago; others appear better handicapped.
runners.comment: Narrow winner over 1m in May; still 5lb higher and others appear better handicapped

runners.name: Unchartedterritory
runners.spotlight: Hung left but took form to a new level when off the mark at Carlisle (1m1f, good to soft) in June; patience has been needed in pursuit of similar ground but considered from 5lb higher; trainer won this last year.
runners.comment: Took form to new level at Carlisle (1m1f, good/soft) in June; considered from 5lb higher.

runners.name: Dryburgh
runners.spotlight: 0-10; runner-up in two of his last three races, failing to get a clear run when a close second at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) two months ago; on a positive trajectory but with more required from 4lb higher.
runners.comment: Not clear run when close 2nd at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) in June; up 4lb

runners.name: Ibn Altheeb
runners.spotlight: AW winner (8.5f) for David Loughnane; creditable third to Unchartedterritory at Carlisle (1m1f; blinkers replaced cheekpieces) in June but he found little at Hamilton (1m3f) subsequently; stablemate Mr Lincoln looks to have a better chance.
runners.comment: Third to Unchartedterritory at Carlisle (1m1f) in June; found little since

runners.name: Mr Lincoln
runners.spotlight: Did well to finish third after stumbling at the start at Carlisle (1m1f, good) last month and has since run well over hurdles; no issue with track, trip or ground conditions and has possibilities for a trainer who has won this three times since 2021.
runners.comment: In form on the Flat and over hurdles; conditions are fine; has possibilities

runners.name: Path To Peace
runners.spotlight: Modicum of promise in 1m4f maiden at Fairyhouse last month; left Willie McCreery for 8,000gns and makes handicap debut in change of headgear (blinkers) for new yard; worth a market check.
runners.comment: Minor promise on 3rd start in Ireland; sold 8,000gns since; handicap/yard debut
runners.owner: Mrs K Oliver And Miss K Scott

runners.name: Natzor
runners.spotlight: Won twice for David O'Meara on Newcastle AW (1m2f) in 2024 but 0-12 on turf; out of sorts last year, and has failed to beat a rival in last two appearances, at Newcastle and Redcar; mark is in freefall but plenty to prove.
runners.comment: 0-12 on turf; failed to beat a rival in last two runs on AW and turf; has plenty to prove

races.race_name: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap

runners.name: Military Leader
runners.spotlight: Likeably consistent dual winner who won't mind what the weather does, with recent seconds at about 1m coming on soft and good to firm; pretty solid, other than this is a step up in class.
runners.comment: Running well and pretty solid, other than this is a step up in class

runners.name: Jannas Journey
runners.spotlight: Did well to come from so far back and win at Carlisle (1m, good) last month and the race wasn't run to suit at Hamilton since; this could be a better fit for her and she's back in good form.
runners.comment: Did well to win from off the pace at Carlisle; leaders never came back at Hamilton

runners.name: Theoryofeverything
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on his best form and some of that has been here, although not on his latest visit in July when only eighth; however, he's one of a few in here who would appreciate softening ground and firmly enters the reckoning.
runners.comment: On a good mark and he's one of a few in here who would appreciate some rain

runners.name: Hale End
runners.spotlight: Kept on well for a seventh career success over C&D 19 days ago but he's gone back up 5lb and has never won anything better than a Class 5; others preferred.
runners.comment: Recent course winner but back up 5lb and has never won anything better than a Class 5

runners.name: Breakdancer
runners.spotlight: Gave it a good go from the front at Southwell (7f; fine at 1m) recently but he's been found wanting a few times since his last win, off 7lb lower on the AW last August; rain is forecast and he's unraced on ground slower than good.
runners.comment: He's now been found wanting a few times since his last win off 7lb lower on the AW

runners.name: Milteye
runners.spotlight: Ran moderately on most recent outing 50 days ago but mostly consistent for current yard and any rain would be much welcomed.
runners.comment: Mostly consistent for current yard and any rain would be much welcomed
runners.owner: Rise One Racing And W A Bethell

runners.name: High Point
runners.spotlight: Made all on his final start for Ross Burdon at Yarmouth (11.5f, soft) in June, after which he changed hands for 19,000gns; rain would be a bonus but he did trail home last at Hamilton only last week (1m5f) and has a good bit to prove at 1m.
runners.comment: Rain would be a bonus but he did trail home last at Hamilton only last week

runners.name: Walsingham
runners.spotlight: On a perfectly good mark, he won't mind rain and he ran surprisingly well to be fifth in last week's Golden Mile at Glorious Goodwood; lots to like.
runners.comment: He ran surprisingly well to be fifth in last week's Golden Mile at Glorious Goodwood

runners.name: Count Palatine
runners.spotlight: All four wins have been at 7f but he hasn't had many chances at this trip, over which he ran third on his penultimate start at Carlisle; had a break since a bad run in June and has possibilities.
runners.comment: All four wins have been at 7f but hasn't had many chances at this trip (3rd in May)

runners.name: Bravais
runners.spotlight: Successful in France and Ireland; impossible to make a case on his five runs for Ian Williams but he'll probably come good again at some point and any rain wouldn't harm his cause.
runners.comment: He'll probably come good again at some point and any rain wouldn't harm his cause

races.race_name: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap

runners.name: Whiskey Kisses
runners.spotlight: Not yet off the mark and was vulnerable in her early handicaps but she made a good fist of it when third on the wing over C&D (good to firm) in July; not so good here since but that was her third run in two weeks and will perhaps be all the better for more of a break this time.
runners.comment: Maiden who ran well over C&D in July; not so good since but had more of a break this time

runners.name: Lanarra
runners.spotlight: Signed off 2yo season with 6f win on Newcastle AW; thereabouts in all three 6f races this year and there's little between her and Mr Cool on recent C&D form; however, she was struggling to keep up from some way out before coming home strongly and this test may again be on the sharp side.
runners.comment: Thereabouts in three 6f races in 2026; best work late when 3rd to Mr Cool over C&D latest

runners.name: Mr Cool
runners.spotlight: All turf runs on good or quicker ground; has had a busy year with some mixed results but he's taken a healthy drop in the weights and nearly nicked a Carlisle race in July; returned to that level when imposing himself on a C&D race 12 days ago and, back up 4lb, should have a big say.
runners.comment: Took advantage of a healthy weights drop when C&D winner latest; back up 4lb; big say

runners.name: Doon The Glen
runners.spotlight: Suited by Hamilton and was winning for the second time there two starts ago (both 6f; good to soft and good to firm); found little returned to 5f on this track since and the yard's other two runners look more likely.
runners.comment: Gained second Hamilton win (6f) in July; found little here latest; others more likely

runners.name: Annie Edson Taylor
runners.spotlight: Best form of the year when persevering well to win at Thirsk (6f, good) in June but disappointingly failed to do herself justice at Hamilton next time, a track where she won and went close (in a higher grade than this) last autumn; has had a short break since and may well revive.
runners.comment: Persevered well to win at Thirsk (6f) in June; disappointed next time; had short break

runners.name: Taaklam
runners.spotlight: 0-8; involved in some hard-fought finishes over 6f on AW but he probably needs a bit more than a close fifth of five in his first turf handicap, at Catterick in May; ran better than the bare result back on AW last week but still needs to show he's as effective on grass, especially with rain about.
runners.comment: 0-8; involved in some tight finishes on AW but needs to show he can do it on turf

runners.name: Masai Angel
runners.spotlight: Ought to be open to some improvement at this level but he again failed to conserve his energy on handicap debut at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) in July and his challenge was very short-lived; reservations.
runners.comment: Again pulled hard and found little on handicap debut at Thirsk (6f); reservations

runners.name: Thunderstorm Katie
runners.spotlight: All five wins between July and October last year, at 6f and 5f, including this race (good); runner-up four times this year and her latest Hamilton run can be consigned to history as she'd run the day before; respected, although serious rain wouldn't be ideal.
runners.comment: All five wins between July and October 2025; some good seconds this year; rain not ideal

runners.name: Ukiyo
runners.spotlight: Off the mark in 6f handicap at Cork (yielding) last September; has been placed in big-field handicaps at 6f and 7f for this yard in 2026 and although below best when last seen in June she shouldn't be out of this, especially if the ground deteriorates.
runners.comment: Won at Cork (6f, yielding) as 4yo; some creditable runs for new yard in 2026; rain helpful

runners.name: Elemma
runners.spotlight: Minor promise when qualifying but she was 22-1 when beaten a long way on her handicap/AW debut at Newcastle (7f) in June; too far behind there to consider seriously back on turf but at least the return to 6f should suit.
runners.comment: Too far back on handicap/AW debut to fancy today but the return to 6f should suit

runners.name: Highfield Sunshine
runners.spotlight: Close up in 7f events as a 3yo but she hasn't been her old self at 7f and 6f this year, in different headgear in two of her last three starts (none today); looks unlikely for now.
runners.comment: Close up in 7f events as 3yo but not her old self this year, back over 6f latest

runners.name: Kelpie Grey
runners.spotlight: Winless since 7f success here in May 2024 and has yet to find his true form this year (beaten favourite three times; behind Mr Cool here last time) but he ran well on occasions in better 6f races than this in 2025 and won't mind what the weather does; quite well treated now and a revival could be imminent.
runners.comment: Winless since May 2024 but quite well treated on best 2025 form; revival possible

runners.name: Impressor
runners.spotlight: Eight wins, all on good to soft or slower, include one over C&D; ran a cracker when fourth of 17 on Doncaster reappearance in March but he's kept his distance since, even when ground conditions looked suitable, but the more rain the better.
runners.comment: All eight wins on good to soft or slower; mixed since good comeback run but down weights

races.race_name: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap

runners.name: Yaaser
runners.spotlight: Talented and well treated; multiple wins include two over C&D; nearly all his wins under Paul Mulrennan, who prefers Sanafi Zabeel, but he's also gone well for Lauren Young and ran creditably for her at Hamilton last week; the likely strong pace will suit and he's capable of a big run.
runners.comment: Talented and well treated; creditable 3rd at Hamilton latest; capable of a big run

runners.name: Milford Grange
runners.spotlight: Capable of better than he's shown on his last two starts at York, unsuccessfully tried over 1m then visored (left off today) in a higher grade; has possibilities on his close second to Circle Of Trust over C&D (soft) in June, albeit the latter pulled out extra when challenged; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Had excuses of late; has possibilities on earlier C&D form with Circle Of Trust

runners.name: Supreme Clarets
runners.spotlight: Has led but not dependent on tactics; slowly away and never threatened at Chester latest but a first win shouldn't be far away on earlier narrow defeats, at Musselburgh and Carlisle (both 7f; good and good to firm), closely matched with Black Storm on the latter occasion; thereabouts.
runners.comment: No threat after slow start latest but has a 7f handicap in him on earlier narrow defeats

runners.name: Circle Of Trust
runners.spotlight: Nearly made a successful switch to handicaps at Yarmouth (7f, good to soft) last September, just held by one who won three of his next five starts; had a quiet start to 2026 but did better when prominently ridden and having a little in hand against Milford Grange over C&D (soft) in June; up 3lb; capable of better.
runners.comment: Improved form when C&D winner (soft) in June; up 3lb; looks capable of better
runners.owner: Mrs R G Hillen And Partner

runners.name: Black Storm
runners.spotlight: Sole win in 7f AW maiden at Dundalk as 3yo; slightly frustrating for this yard as he's been involved in some tight finishes for them, including in this race last year and when just behind Supreme Clarets at Carlisle (7f, good to firm) in July, but fitting blinkers could help; solid chance, if so.
runners.comment: Some close calls in Britain, including in this race last year and on latest; now blinkered

runners.name: Sanafi Zabeel
runners.spotlight: First British win when making all at Hamilton (about 1m, good to firm) in May; has remained in form there since without looking ahead of his mark but this first attempt at 7f looks worth investigating for last year's winning trainer.
runners.comment: Front-runner; sole British win at about 1m; drawn widest now dropped to 7f

runners.name: Ubetterseethis
runners.spotlight: Often leads; narrow Chester winner (7f, good to firm) last August on handicap debut and he ran much better back there in June than he had the time before at York; another bold show is on the cards.
runners.comment: Often leads; returned to form at Chester latest; bold bid on the cards from a low draw

runners.name: Tap Dancer
runners.spotlight: Won 1m2f Bath novice as 2yo but just middling form from the front here of late, over 1m2f, 7f and 6f; dropping down the weights but this is competitive and the other two from the yard look more interesting.
runners.comment: Middling form from the front here of late; down weights but this is competitive

runners.name: Highfield Viking
runners.spotlight: Three of four wins have been at 7f, including over C&D (good) last August; back on his latest winning mark after failing to find his form this year and has plenty to prove following a 14l defeat at Doncaster in June.
runners.comment: C&D winner; back on latest winning mark; work to do on this year's form, beaten 14l latest

runners.name: Runninsonofagun
runners.spotlight: Handles all surfaces; many good runs on turf over the last year, making all in first-time blinkers here (1m, good to firm) in July and two solid efforts since; headgear left off now tackling 7f for the first time since 2yo days in Ireland but has another good run in him.
runners.comment: Won over 1m here in July; first 7f run since 2yo season; headgear left off; not dismissed

runners.name: Stoic Poet
runners.spotlight: Maiden; one of his best efforts came over C&D (good to soft) last summer and yard has won two of the last five runnings but this one needs to improve on his handicap form so far, most recently when bleeding from the nose in June; now hooded.
runners.comment: Ran well over C&D last summer but work to do on handicap form since; bled from nose latest

runners.name: Yy Spirit
runners.spotlight: Took a step forward when winning 6f novice on Newcastle AW last December but she's had two crushing defeats in handicaps this year for new yard; can only watch.
runners.comment: Won 6f AW novice as 2yo but suffered two crushing defeats for new yard this year

runners.name: Phoenix Of Dreams
runners.spotlight: 7f winner on Newcastle AW in March; back on turf for the first time since last October but he's 8lb lower today and he does act on grass; however, jockey bookings suggest Highfield Viking is the stable preferred.
runners.comment: AW winner at 7f in March; first turf run since October but acts on grass; yard runs two

races.race_name: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes

runners.name: Sassy Glory
runners.spotlight: Runner-up (beaten over 4l) in this last year, but yet to win on turf (0-17); gamely fended off the frustrating Little Ted at Newcastle (1m; 11-2) on penultimate start, but reportedly ran flat back there on latest; stable have more obvious chance with Wicklow Way.
runners.comment: Runner-up in this last year, but yet to win on turf (0-17); stablemate of Wicklow Way.
runners.owner: Ursa Major & Mark Walford Racing Club

runners.name: Wicklow Way
runners.spotlight: Well backed and returned to form when winning classified event at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) last week; that was steadily run but he was an emphatic winner; every chance if able to reproduce equivalent level on turf (0-9); stablemate of Sassy Glory.
runners.comment: Won classified event at Newcastle (1m2f) last week; every chance if repeating form on turf

runners.name: Resdev Time
runners.spotlight: 12-race maiden; placed over this trip at Beverley (beaten 3l) in June but disappointing since, beaten nearly 50l (last of seven) over 1m4f at Pontefract latest; focus elsewhere.
runners.comment: 12-race maiden; beaten nearly 50l (last) over 1m4f at Pontefract latest; focus elsewhere.

runners.name: Falaise Blanc
runners.spotlight: 1-25; keeping reasonable form over further until a low-key effort at Musselburgh (1m5f, good) last week; dropping back to 1m2f is helpful (was third in this last year) but others still make more appeal.
runners.comment: 1-25; low-key effort at Musselburgh (1m5f, good) last week; others make more appeal.

runners.name: Patrick Street
runners.spotlight: Irish raider; ran far better than finishing position suggests (pecked badly at second-last) over hurdles at Kilbeggan (2m3f) a fortnight ago; cosy Flat winner at Limerick (1m4f, yielding) in April and needs respecting at this basement level.
runners.comment: Cosy Flat winner at Limerick (1m4f, yielding) in April; needs respecting at basement level

runners.name: Flying Moonlight
runners.spotlight: 0-5; better since joining this trainer, twice placed over 1m here (Class 6); run style wouldn't suggest he's the most obvious candidate for 1m2f, but pedigree does offer hope; still open to improvement; isn't discounted.
runners.comment: 0-5; twice placed over a mile here (Class 6) since joining this trainer; isn't discounted.

runners.name: Storm On Jura
runners.spotlight: Ten-race maiden; fourth (not far behind Falaise Blanc) at Musselburgh (12.5f; 33-1) in June, but weakened over C&D (raced keenly) subsequently; level of competition suitable, but others are easier to recommend.
runners.comment: Ten-race maiden; fourth at Musselburgh (12.5f) in June; failed to back up over C&D since.

runners.name: Sanny Doo
runners.spotlight: Yet to win (0-8) and not many positives to take from latest C&D effort; Mulrennan takes the ride aboard this stablemate of Storm On Jura; opposable.
runners.comment: Yet to win (0-8); Mulrennan takes ride aboard stablemate of Storm On Jura; opposable.

runners.name: One More Bottle
runners.spotlight: 1-18, that win in a newly applied visor here (1m, good to soft; 16-1) last July; finished sixth behind Golden Valour on return from six-month break over C&D latest; could strip fitter.
runners.comment: 1-18; sixth behind Golden Valour on return from a six-month break over C&D latest.

runners.name: Raise The Stakes
runners.spotlight: Failed to win for William Knight (0-7), beaten at odds-on at Yarmouth (1m2f classified) on final start for that trainer; visor (worn twice) has yielded some improvement; wise to monitor this 7,000gns purchase on stable debut.
runners.comment: Failed to win for W. Knight (0-7); wise to monitor this 7,000gns purchase on stable debut.

runners.name: Golden Valour
runners.spotlight: Veteran (5-81) stablemate of Zebra Star; respectable third over 1m here (good to firm) in July, but could make only minimal inroads over C&D (fifth; 22-1) latest; this is a slightly easier task.
runners.comment: Could make only minimal inroads over C&D (fifth; 22-1) latest; this is slightly easier.

runners.name: Zebra Star
runners.spotlight: Dual course winner, the most recent over this trip (Class 6, good to soft) over a year ago; no obvious excuses (form figures 9549) in 2026, but does have a capable 5lb claimer aboard, and further rain could assist; stablemate of Golden Valour.
runners.comment: No obvious excuses (form figures 9549) in 2026; stablemate of Golden Valour.

races.race_name: Saint Lucia Let Her Inspire You Handicap

runners.name: Balgowan
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D in April and he's finished second in both runs since including a close call at Kempton (2m; cheekpieces reapplied) in June; only 1lb higher here and he's a big player again back at this track.
runners.comment: Won over C&D in April and he went close at Kempton latest; big player off only 1lb higher

runners.name: Fabled Spirit
runners.spotlight: Found improvement upped to 1m6f on handicap debut when a close third of four at Bath (firm) last week; this looks tougher on this step up to 2m but he stayed on well last time and he's a half-brother to two AW winners; in the mix.
runners.comment: Close third of four on handicap debut at Bath (1m6f) last week; in the mix upped to 2m

runners.name: Sir Griflet
runners.spotlight: Creditable fourth in a Wolverhampton handicap (1m4f, AW) in June but he's finished tailed off in three subsequent runs; overall record is now 0-8 and he has a lot to prove at this new trip.
runners.comment: Eight-race maiden who has been tailed off in his last three runs and is untried at 2m

runners.name: Last Flight
runners.spotlight: Unexposed filly who got much closer to the target with a strong-finishing third in a Wolverhampton handicap (1m6f, AW) last month; that was promising in her final run for James Ferguson and she needs a close look on this step up to 2m.
runners.comment: Close third at Wolverhampton latest and she looks interesting upped to 2m for new yard

runners.name: Femme Fatale
runners.spotlight: 0-6 but she ran her best race so far when a clear second behind a major improver over C&D last month; nudged up 2lb but she kept on well last time and should have more to offer over this trip; respected.
runners.comment: 0-6 but she was a clear second over C&D last month; respected off 2lb higher

runners.name: Man Of The Sea
