runners.spotlight: All of his 13 Flat wins have been on turf and he's 0-9 on AW; returned to form with fair fourth at Bath (2m1f, good) in June but he's struggled in both subsequent runs (hurdles/Flat) and others are preferred; stablemate of Trooper.
runners.comment: Has struggled in last two runs and all of his 13 Flat wins have been on turf

runners.name: Si White
runners.spotlight: Big improvement upped to 1m3f on handicap/seasonal debut when scoring at Southwell (AW) last month; held in third when favourite at Wolverhampton (1m4f) last week but this unexposed 3yo has stamina in his pedigree and he could resume his progress on this switch to a staying trip; interesting contender with blinkers added.
runners.comment: Unexposed 3yo and he could find more progress on this step up to 2m; interesting contender
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing Xxx & Chris Rees

runners.name: Trooper
runners.spotlight: Five-time Flat winner in Belgium/Germany (one in blinkers) but he's struggled in five runs runs for current yard (three over hurdles); dropped another 4lb but he was beaten 12l on turf here (1m5f) last time and has a lot to prove at this new trip.
runners.comment: Five wins in Belgium/Germany but he's struggled for current yard; has a lot to prove

runners.name: October Surprise
runners.spotlight: Beaten 9l or more in all five runs, including on his stable debut over C&D (33-1; first run since gelded) last month; that was after an absence but he needs to show a lot more on this return visit.
runners.comment: Beaten 9l or more in all five runs, including on his stable debut over C&D last month

runners.name: Make A Splash
runners.spotlight: Tailed off over 1m6f, 1m3f and 1m2f in three qualifying runs this summer; now goes handicapping but she needs a transformation on this step up to 2m.
runners.comment: Tailed off in all three runs and she needs a transformation upped to 2m on handicap debut

races.race_name: Hyatt Inclusive Handicap

runners.name: Sunlit Sea
runners.spotlight: Off the mark with an emphatic win on turf here (5f, good to firm) last month and she defied a penalty when making all at Thirsk nine days later; that was a narrow success last time but a 3lb rise looks fair enough and she's a big player again back on AW.
runners.comment: 3yo who has won on turf in her last two starts and is a big player again back on AW

runners.name: Go Lockers Go
runners.spotlight: Won handicaps at Chelmsford (6f, AW) and Yarmouth (5f, good) in the spring but he's gone off the boil recently and was only eighth of 12 at Newcastle last week; has a bit to prove and he's still 3lb higher than for his last success.
runners.comment: Won twice in the spring but he's gone off the boil recently; needs to step up again
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing D Turner B Roberts

runners.name: Arctic Wind
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden for two different yards and he was well below form at Kempton (6f, AW) last month; dropped another 3lb but he's been up and down so far and others are more convincing; stablemate of Guernsey Lady.
runners.comment: Seven-race maiden who was well held at Kempton latest; stablemate of Guernsey Lady

runners.name: Carefree Dream
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in two Goodwood handicaps (5f, soft/good) in June but she didn't really fire at Ascot (sixth of nine) two weeks ago; now drops back in grade but overall record is 1-15 and others are more persuasive.
runners.comment: Runner-up twice this summer but she didn't fire last time and is now 1-15

runners.name: Guernsey Lady
runners.spotlight: Sole win was in a novice last May but she's on a reduced mark and has been placed at Bath (5.6f, good to firm) and Ffos Las (5f, good to soft) in her two runs this season; should go well again after a short break and she's still unexposed on AW.
runners.comment: Placed in both runs this season and she's still unexposed on AW; respected

runners.name: Wyle Cop
runners.spotlight: Returned after a gelding operation with a win at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) in March but he's been generally disappointing since; now 11lb lower than for his win but he struggled at Doncaster last time and is untried on Polytrack; down the list.
runners.comment: Won at Wolverhampton in March but he's been generally disappointing since; down the list

races.race_name: Bay Gardens Handicap

runners.name: Halimede
runners.spotlight: Big improvement upped to 1m4f on handicap debut when beating an odds-on rival by 5l at Catterick (good to firm) on Tuesday; looks well treated under a penalty for that win and she shaped as though this step up to 1m6f should suit; strong contender.
runners.comment: Easy win on handicap debut at Catterick (1m4f) on Tuesday; strong claims under a penalty

runners.name: Darkest Red
runners.spotlight: Ten-race maiden but he's finished runner-up in three of his five runs this season and wasn't beaten far when fourth of five at Epsom (1m4f, good to firm) last time; looks worth a try at this new trip and he's in the mix back on AW.
runners.comment: 0-10 but he's finished runner-up three times this season; could be dangerous at new trip

runners.name: Parc Dosne
runners.spotlight: Well-bred gelding but he's beaten 7l, 9l and 14l in three runs (1m2f/1m) for two different yards this summer; still early days but he needs a transformation now upped to 1m6f on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Well held in maiden/novice events (1m2f/1m) and needs a transformation on handicap debut

runners.name: Cospicua
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-3 in handicaps when scoring at Kempton (1m4f, Polytrack) in March but she's been disappointing in both subsequent runs; still has low mileage but she needs a major revival at this new trip.
runners.comment: Low mileage 3yo but she's been disappointing since her Kempton win in March; bit to prove

runners.name: V Power
runners.spotlight: Three wins at Wolverhampton (1m6f, Tapeta) this year, the latest when narrowly beating a subsequent winner last month; only fifth of eight at Kempton on Wednesday but that was at 2m in a Class 5 and he's not ruled out on this drop back in trip/grade.
runners.comment: Three wins (1m6f) this year and he had excuse over 2m on Wednesday; dangerous back in trip

runners.name: Artavian
runners.spotlight: Sole win was in a heavy-ground handicap at Windsor (11.4f) in October 2024; ran well when third at Chepstow (1m2f, good to soft) in June but he struggled here (2m) last time and that took his AW record to 0-10; others preferred.
runners.comment: Hard to predict and he made it 0-10 on AW when struggling over 2m here last time
runners.owner: G E Bassett & P R Chamings

runners.name: Shopaholic
runners.spotlight: Well held in three qualifying runs (1m2f) but she made a promising start in handicaps when runner-up at Wolverhampton (1m6f, Tapeta) last month; up 3lb but she was long way clear of the third last time and is open to more progress at staying trips; respected.
runners.comment: Improved form when runner-up on handicap debut at Wolverhampton (1m6f); respected up 3lb

races.race_name: Calabash Cove EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Kanzi
runners.spotlight: 36,000gns yearling; Ghaiyyath filly out of 1m-1m2f winner (including Listed; RPR 100); attracted some support into 9-1 at Ayr (7f, good to firm) last month and she travelled well for a long way before finishing runner-up behind an experienced rival; that was a promising start and she's the standout contender on that form.
runners.comment: Scopey filly who made a promising start when runner-up at Ayr; strong contender

runners.name: Saffron Bay
runners.spotlight: Lucky Vega filly; second foal; dam unraced sister to 1m4f Listed winner Voodoo Queen, half-sister to 7f Listed winner Tinker Toy, out of 7f 2yo Group 1 winner; yard is in good form and she needs watching in market on debut.
runners.comment: Well-bred filly and she needs watching in market on debut

runners.name: Ozone Friendly
runners.spotlight: Sixth foal; half-sister to three winners including White Chapel Road (7f 2yo; RPR 82) and Climate Precedent (2m hurdle); dam unraced half-sister to useful 6f 2yo winner Alamode, family of Champion Stakes winner Alborada and Arc winner Alpinista; interesting newcomer and she needs a close look.
runners.comment: Plenty to like on paper and she needs a close look on debut

runners.name: Chaise Longue
runners.spotlight: 38,000gns yearling; 18-1 at Epsom (7f, good to firm) last month and she was always in rear after a slow start; should know more this time but she needs to leave her initial form well behind.
runners.comment: 18-1 and she finished last of eight on Epsom debut (7f) last month

runners.name: Amethyst Star
runners.spotlight: Without Parole filly who has been beaten 10l in two turf runs (6f) this summer but she's out of a well-related AW winner and is a possible improver on this step up to 1m; one to keep an eye on.
runners.comment: Struggled in two 6f runs this summer but she's a possible improver on this step up to 1m

runners.name: Senorita Luna
runners.spotlight: Always in rear and was beaten 14l when seventh of nine on Wolverhampton debut (7f, Tapeta) last month; others preferred.
runners.comment: Always in rear and was beaten 14l on Wolverhampton debut (7f, Tapeta) last month
runners.owner: Mohamed Rashid Hamdan Al Saadi & Partner

races.race_name: Hewanorra Handicap

runners.name: Huscal
runners.spotlight: Maiden and novice winner who is yet to win a handicap but he finished a creditable third at Newbury (7f) last month and ran to a similar level when runner-up here (7.6f, good to firm) last time; should go well again off the same mark and he's still unexposed on AW.
runners.comment: In-form 4yo who has run well on turf in his last two starts and is respected back on AW

runners.name: Tattie Bogle
runners.spotlight: Won at Beverley (7.4f, good) in June and he ran another good race when a clear second there last time; this return to Polytrack is no problem and he should give it another good shot with cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: In-form 4yo who is effective on Polytrack and should go well again in new headgear

runners.name: Arantes Nascimento
runners.spotlight: Ended a long losing run at Kempton (7f, Polytrack) in April and he's held his form back on turf since, including a close call at Salisbury (6f, soft) and a 2l sixth in a big field at Ascot (7f, good to firm) last month; still looks on a workable mark and he could be a big factor back on AW.
runners.comment: Won at Kempton in April and he's held his form back on turf since; shortlisted

runners.name: Port Road
runners.spotlight: All three wins have been on Polytrack and latest was over C&D in April; only 2lb higher than for that success but he's been well held in both subsequent runs (AW/turf) and needs to rediscover his spark.
runners.comment: Won over C&D in April but he's been well held in both subsequent runs; risks attached

runners.name: Rogue Supremacy
runners.spotlight: Two turf wins (5.5f/5f) for David O'Meara last summer but he's 0-7 for current yard and was out the back at Wolverhampton (6f) last time; continues to drop down the weights but he has plenty to prove back up in trip; headgear removed.
runners.comment: On reduced mark but he's 0-7 for current yard and has plenty to prove back up in trip

runners.name: Bold Suitor
runners.spotlight: Eight AW wins and latest was over C&D in April; creditable run at Kempton (1m) last time and he's only 2lb higher than for that last success; not ruled out on this drop back in trip.
runners.comment: Eight AW wins and latest was over C&D on his penultimate run; in the mix

runners.name: Red Hat Eagle
runners.spotlight: All four wins have been at 1m including three on Polytrack; well treated on old form and he's run respectably in last two starts but his last win was over two years ago and others are more persuasive.
runners.comment: On dangerous mark but all wins have been at 1m and latest was in July 2024

races.race_name: Rodney Bay Classified Stakes

runners.name: A Lott Of Kane
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been in sprint handicaps at Wolverhampton and latest was after wind surgery last week; hit a personal best with that comfortable success and he is a big player again despite conceding weight all round back in a classified event.
runners.comment: Had wind op before his win at Wolverhampton last week; big player despite conceding weight

runners.name: Dr Ali
runners.spotlight: Won a classified event at Wolverhampton (6f, Tapeta) in March but he's not come close to that form in four subsequent runs; visor is now tried and he needs a major revival back on Polytrack.
runners.comment: Won a classified at Wolverhampton in March but he's been disappointing since; new headgear

runners.name: Roman Spring
runners.spotlight: Hard to predict and was well held at Salisbury last time but he looks interesting on his third in a Newbury handicap (6f, good to firm) in June; has claims if he can recapture that form and his last win was at this track.
runners.comment: Hard to predict but he's a course winner who has claims on his best form this year

runners.name: Henry Tudor
runners.spotlight: Improved form when landing a classified event at Chelmsford (6f, AW) in February but he's not finished closer than seventh in four subsequent runs; overall record is now 1-13 and others are more convincing.
runners.comment: Landed a classified event at Chelmsford in February but he has form figures of 9987 since

runners.name: Just King High
runners.spotlight: Has the same strike-rate (1-22) as Horus and his win was in November 2024; has been up and down this year but he was runner-up twice on AW (7f) in March and he didn't get the best of runs when a respectable sixth at Windsor (5f) last time; has another switch of headgear and he could be dangerous back up in trip.
runners.comment: Some creditable efforts this year and he could be dangerous back up in trip

runners.name: Edergole's Gift
runners.spotlight: Dual Polytrack winner but she has an overall strike-rate of 3-38 and has been beaten 5l or more in her last five runs; has a change of headgear but she needs to raise her game back in trip.
runners.comment: Has modest strike-rate of 3-38 and she's been well held in last five runs; down the list

runners.name: Horus
runners.spotlight: Sole win was in December 2024 but that was over C&D; finished down the field in three runs for current yard but the saddle slipped at Brighton (7f, good) last time and he was only beaten around 2l; could go well on this drop back in trip and he's not ruled out.
runners.comment: Just 1-22 but his win was over C&D and he could go well on this drop back in trip

runners.name: Rainbow Sorbet
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden who has generally struggled so far and was last of six in a Leicester handicap (5f, good to firm) last time; still early days but she needs a transformation back up in trip; visor reapplied.
runners.comment: Has generally struggled in her six starts and she needs a transformation back up in trip
runners.owner: M Robinson, S Holden & T Helliwell

runners.name: Music And Song
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 3yo who is 0-8 and has not finished closer than 9l to a winner; has plenty to prove for new yard and she's untried at sprint trips; cheekpieces removed.
runners.comment: Ex-Irish 3yo who is 0-8 and has not finished closer than 9l to a winner; stable debut

runners.name: Paint Your Palette
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo but she's been tailed off at increasingly big prices in her three runs (7f/1m) since December; now switches to a classified event but she needs lots of improvement on this drop to 6f.
runners.comment: Unexposed filly but she needs lots of improvement on this drop to 6f

races.race_name: Test Stakes Presented By Ticketmaster (Fillies) (Grade 1) (Dirt)

runners.name: Percy's Bar
runners.spotlight: Ran a bit below expectations (sent off 11-10) when fifth in a black type (Churchill Downs) two months ago; could have a say if replicating the best of her form and she goes well fresh.
runners.comment: She has defied a similar absence before and in with a shout.

runners.name: Explora
runners.spotlight: Scored narrowly in an allowance listed (Churchill Downs) when back to this distance two months ago; has chalked up four wins from her last seven; the Bob Baffert operation is running hot currently; leading claims.
runners.comment: Warrants plenty of respect; narrow winner two months ago.
runners.owner: Michael E Pegram, Karl Watson & Paul Weitman

runners.name: Sippin Pretty
runners.spotlight: Had a couple of these behind when springing a 28-1 surprise four weeks ago in an allowance Grade 3; has won three of her five career starts.
runners.comment: Accounted for a few of these 29 days ago; has won three of her five career starts.
runners.owner: Randall L Bloch, Six Column Stables LLC Et Al

runners.name: Movie Night
runners.spotlight: Goes for a hat-trick today and has a nice pedigree (by Speightstown); ran out a ready winner over 6 1/2f at Churchill Downs (allowance optional claimer) 45 days ago; despite that Churchill Downs success, one to tread carefully with.
runners.comment: Despite that Churchill Downs success, only limited appeal.

runners.name: On Time Girl
runners.spotlight: Successful four times in her last seven starts; favourite and only narrowly beaten in an allowance listed (Churchill Downs) behind Explora two months ago; competitive shout.
runners.comment: Hard to dismiss; just touched off at evens two months ago.

runners.name: Goodall
runners.spotlight: Just denied over 6 1/2f here (allowance Grade 3) behind Sippin Pretty last month; track has proven suitable before; has made an impressive start to her career with three wins from six starts; has to be respected.
runners.comment: Easy to see her making an impression; just denied at 85-40 last month.

runners.name: Carmel Coast
runners.spotlight: Beaten 9l into fifth last month in an allowance Grade 3; has winning form at this track; successful twice in her last five starts; easy to oppose.
runners.comment: Unlikely to achieve more than just a supporting role; beaten a fair way last month.
runners.owner: Legion Racing, MHM Stables LLC Et Al

runners.name: Where Luck Lives
runners.spotlight: Attempts to land a hat-trick and two from three in her career so far; won an allowance optional claimer by just over 5l at Churchill Downs in May; despite that Churchill Downs success, may have to settle for supporting role at best.
runners.comment: Despite that Churchill Downs success, not one to rely on.

races.race_name: Fourstardave Stakes (Grade 1) (Turf)

runners.name: Classic Q
runners.spotlight: Improving filly who won Grade 2 Churchill Downs Distaff Turf Mile (by neck from Portfolio Duration, idling in front) and Grade 1 Just A Game Stakes here (1m), on latter occasion impressively by over a length from Mandanaba, making all and lengthening powerfully in straight, never looking likely to be caught; will take a good male to concede weight to her in same form.
runners.comment: Grade 2 and Grade 1 (C&D) wins against fillies showed an improving type; bold bid expected
runners.owner: Gary Barber, Blue Crevalle Racing & Eclipse T'Bred Partners

runners.name: Rhetorical
runners.spotlight: High-class miler (fourth in latest Breeders' Cup Mile) and better than ever in 2026; improved form to win Grade 1 Turf Classic at Churchill Downs (1m1f) in May by 3l from Make Me King, making all; upset in stalls, unable to dominate when around 1l fourth to Deterministic in Manhattan Stakes (9.5f) here afterwards; not seen to best advantage last time and rates as the one to beat.
runners.comment: Dual Grade 1 winner, including at Churchill Downs in May; excuses latest and strong claims
runners.owner: Gary Barber, Cheyenne Stable LLC & Wachtel Stable

runners.name: Lagynos
runners.spotlight: Has racked up ten wins from 28 starts under shrewd placement from Steve Asmussen; completed five-timer in 2026 with Grade 3 Arlington and Grade 2 Wise Dan Stakes wins, both over 8.5f at Churchill Downs; has only tried Grade 1 company once, when only seventh in this last year; maybe in a shade too deep.
runners.comment: Prolific winner at slightly lower level, earning Grade 3 and Grade 2 wins of late; opposed
runners.owner: HRH Prince Sultan Bin Mishal Al Saud

runners.name: Deterministic
runners.spotlight: In the form of his life at present, continuing his winning spree when beating Test Score by half a length in Grade 1 Manhattan Stakes here (9.5f) last time, pressing leader and battling on with great tenacity in the straight; has now won three Grade 1s (including this race in 2025) and looks sure to make a concerted defence of his title.
runners.comment: Triple Grade 1 winner, including over C&D and last time over 9.5f here; must go well again
runners.owner: St Elias Stable, Ken Langone Et Al

runners.name: Mi Bago
runners.spotlight: Smart form on last two starts here, winning black type event in June (8.5f; easily by 4l) then dead-heating with Zulu Kingdom in Grade 3 Kelso (1m); progressive, but does need to improve again to threaten the best here.
runners.comment: Smart form here last two, dead-heating in Grade 3 over this distance; more needed

runners.name: Capitol Hill
runners.spotlight: Has plenty to prove to better this type of rival on all known form, including 3l fourth of ten to dead-heaters Zulu Kingdom and Mi Bago in Grade 3 Kelso over course and distance latest; opposed.
runners.comment: Balance of form short of this grade, including when fourth in Grade 3 over C&D latest

runners.name: Zulu Kingdom
runners.spotlight: Clearly best effort to win Grade 1 Maker's Mark Mile at Keeneland in April by around 1l from One Stripe, dictating steady pace before kicked into clear lead and holding on; creditable efforts on balance of smart form since, dead-heating with Mi Bago (same terms) in Grade 3 Kelso over C&D; faces pressure for lead and opposed on balance.
runners.comment: Got first run when winning Grade 1 at Keeneland in April; bit below this level otherwise
runners.owner: Madaket Stables LLC, Michael Dubb Et Al

races.race_name: Saratoga Derby Stakes Presented By Qatar Racing (Grade 1) (Turf)

runners.name: Glacius
runners.spotlight: Very useful form when third over 1m2f this season in Group 3 Hampton Court Stakes at Royal Ascot (about 1l behind Generic) and in Listed Gala Stakes at Sandown (beaten 2l by Sallaal), accelerating well from rear both times but no extra close home; fits in terms of class and first-time cheekpieces could really help.
runners.comment: Third over 1m2f this season in Group 3 and Listed in Britain, running on; interesting type

runners.name: Title Role
runners.spotlight: Has thrived in 2026, winning Listed race at Meydan (1m) in February, Group 2 German 2,000 Guineas at Cologne (1m) in May and Grade 1 Belmont Derby here (1m1f; beat West End Kid and Remember Mamba in close finish, better placed turning in than either); slightly longer trip does not favour him.
runners.comment: Four wins in 2026 include Grade 1 Belmont Derby here (1m1f); longer trip may not suit

runners.name: Remember Mamba
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten in first three, including Grade 3 Transylvania at Keeneland in April; placed in Grade 1 American Turf at Churchill Downs (8.5f; second to Stark Contrast) and Belmont Derby here (1m1f; close third to Title Role); must go well again.
runners.comment: Placed in Grade 1s at Churchill Downs and here (neck second to Title Role); must go well

runners.name: West End Kid
runners.spotlight: Progressive form in five starts, scoring in maiden at Keeneland in April, allowance at Churchill Downs in May and Grade 3 Pennine Ridge here (8.5f) in June; shaped like best horse, set plenty to do and finishing best, when eye-catching close second to Title Role again here (1m1f) in Grade 1 Belmont Derby; outside draw makes things difficult.
runners.comment: Progressive; unlucky second to Title Role in Grade 1 here (1m1f); can defy tough draw

runners.name: Glavine
runners.spotlight: Useful form when in frame over 8.5f here in Grade 3 Pennine Ridge Stakes (under 2l fourth to West End Kid) and Listed Saranac Stakes (under 1l third to Heeere's Johnny); pitched in deep here and will need a perfect game to reach a place.
runners.comment: In frame over 8.5f here in Grade 3 and Listed here; lots to prove here in better grade
runners.owner: West Paces Racing/Rainbow's End Racing/Michael P Lyden

runners.name: Heeere's Johnny
runners.spotlight: Under 6l fifth to Gstaad in Grade 1 Breeders' Cup Juvenile Turf at Del Mar (1m) last November; 15-1, roughly same level of form when winning Listed race over 8.5f here (8.5f) by neck from Blinging It Back; should be suited by today's longer trip but needs a lot more to contend in this grade.
runners.comment: Useful form in Graded stakes in 2025 and same level winning Listed on return; more needed
runners.owner: Magic Carpet Racing, Catherine W Coyle & Blue Bison Stable

runners.name: Bottas
runners.spotlight: Looked smart prospect when winning first two starts last year, notably Grade 2 Pilgrim Stakes at Aqueduct in October; not disgraced here in 2026, third to West End Kid in Grade 3 Pennine Ridge and fifth to Title Role in Grade 1 Belmont Derby (1m1f), in latter poorly placed; place claims.
runners.comment: Grade 2 winner, too much to do when fifth in Grade 1 here (1m1f) last time; place chance

runners.name: McCready
runners.spotlight: Won two of his first four starts on turf, include allowance race at Keeneland in April over this trip (beat Noble Dynasty by a neck); improved effort on dirt debut at Delaware (sloppy going; scored by two and a half lengths) last time; should be just as effective back on grass but lots to find.
runners.comment: Turf and dirt (sloppy) winner but has lots to find at this level

runners.name: The Big Con
runners.spotlight: Looked a bright prospect on Tapeta as a juvenile, winning maiden at Presque Isle Downs (1m) and Grade 3 Grey Stakes at Woodbine (8.5f; beat smart Silent Tactic by under 1l); huge task on turf debut and on first start for nine months; blinkers retained.
runners.comment: Won maiden and Grade 3 on Tapeta but very stiff task after nine-month break on turf debut
runners.owner: Reeves Thoroughbred Racing, Tony Weintraub & Brandon Dalinka

races.race_name: Whitney Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)

runners.name: Sovereignty
runners.spotlight: US Horse of the Year in 2025; won Kentucky Derby at Churchill Downs and three times at Saratoga afterwards, notably Grade 1 Belmont Stakes and Grade 1 Travers (by 10l); well below best this season, second to White Abarrio in Grade 2 at Oaklawn on reappearance, then really disappointing third to Magnitude in Grade 1 Stephen Foster at Churchill Downs, weakening tamely stretch; brilliant at best and goes really well here but optimism for return to form rests on news of encouraging workouts, rather than anything seen on track.
runners.comment: US Horse of the Year in 2025, but disappointing twice this year; needs to bounce back

runners.name: Nitrogen
runners.spotlight: Top-class filly, surely the best of her sex around two turns on dirt; deeply impressive in 13l win over Bless The Broken in Grade 1 Ogden Phipps over C&D on latest start, still going strongly with field in trouble turning in, changing gears and soon a long way clear (outstanding time); much stiffer task against males but coming off a performance of rare standing.
runners.comment: Very impressive in Grade 1 over C&D against females; stiffer task but the one to beat

runners.name: Magnitude
runners.spotlight: Has improved into top-class colt as 4yo, winning Grade 3 Razorback Handicap at Oaklawn (8.5f; by 4l) in February, Grade 1 Dubai World Cup at Meydan (1m2f) in March and Grade 1 Stephen Foster Stakes at Churchill Downs in June (1m1f; broke out of stalls beforehand, again made all and beat Baeza by a length and a quarter); owns deep stamina and courage and deserves to be regarded as the division's leading male performer.
runners.comment: Top-class form in 2026, winning Grade 1s at Meydan and Churchill Downs; must go well

runners.name: White Abarrio
runners.spotlight: High-class form at best, winning four Grade 1s including 2023 Breeders' Cup Classic at Santa Anita and 2025 Pegasus World Cup (1m1f) at Gulfstream Park; returned to form when winning Grade 2 Oaklawn Handicap in April (by 2l from Sovereignty) but moderate fourth of five behind Magnitude last time; difficult to predict.
runners.comment: High-class form at best, as when winning Grade 2 at Oaklawn in April; hard to predict
runners.owner: C2 Racing Stable LLC, Gary Barber & La Milagrosa Stable LLC

runners.name: Forged Steel
runners.spotlight: Hard-charging front runner; got loose early in Grade 2 at Santa Anita in May (1m2f) and proceeded to register very smart effort in beating Malarchuk by 10l; nowhere near that level in the face of even mild pressure up front and will not find this group accommodating.
runners.comment: Clearly best effort to win Grade 2 at Santa Anita on penultimate start; has to dominate
runners.owner: C2 Racing Stable, Mathis Stable LLC & TCC Stables LLC

runners.name: Antiquarian
runners.spotlight: Career-best effort last August in trouble-affected Grade 1 Jockey Club Gold Cup here (1m2f); well below that form in three of four starts since, except when winning Grade 3 Westchester Stakes at Aqueduct (1m) by 6l from Bishops Bay; very smart on his day but finds this type of rival tough.
runners.comment: Grade 1 winner of 1m2f here but generally struggles against top-class rivals like these

runners.name: Tiztastic
runners.spotlight: Nowhere near this class yet; won allowance race at Churchill Downs in May before moderate third to Phileas Fogg in Grade 2 Suburban Stakes here (1m2f) last month.
runners.comment: Moderate third in Grade 2 here last time; not this class on all known form
runners.owner: Winchell Thoroughbreds LLC, Derrick Smith Et Al

runners.name: Baeza
runners.spotlight: Smart horse on his day who beat Magnitude by just over 2l in Grade 1 Pennsylvania Derby (1m1f) last September; creditable efforts this year, around 1l second to same rival in Grade 1 Stephen Foster at Churchill Downs last time, running on; not far behind these on balance and could take a hand if the early pace is too strong.
runners.comment: Smart horse on his day, second to Magnitude in Grade 1 last time, running on; place claims
runners.owner: C R K Stable LLC & Grandview Equine

races.race_name: Prix de Reux (Group 3) (Turf)

runners.name: Tenability
runners.spotlight: Unraced as a 2yo and went on quite the winning streak last year when a tongue-tie was applied, progressing from an opening mark of 81 to 100 when he was second in the Group 3 Cumberland Lodge Stakes (1m4f, soft) by October; bagged a career best on his seasonal return but didn't need to repeat that when beating popular stablemate Hamish two months ago; seems to handle most ground, so leading claims.
runners.comment: Multiple winner last year and enjoying a good 2026; leading claims

runners.name: Presage Nocturne
runners.spotlight: Notably went off favourite for last year's Melbourne Cup, albeit he finished down the field, following a solid season, and has been steadily improving in 2026, most recently landing a 1m4f good-ground Listed race at Lyon Parilly a month and a half ago under this rider by 4l; beaten a nose by Parachutiste on the same terms prior to that, so hard to dismiss.
runners.comment: Steadily back to form this year and clear winner last time; hard to dismiss
runners.owner: Paolo Zambelli, Carlo Pellegatti Et Al

runners.name: Parachutiste
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m4f good-ground Listed contest at Clairefontaine last year in a solid season and has run three smart races following a gelding operation in 2026, beating Presage Nocturne two runs ago (1m4f, good) before narrowly denied by Sons And Lovers upped to 1m6f; seems adaptable with regard to trip and should place a part.
runners.comment: Run three smart races following a gelding operation in 2026; player
runners.owner: Qatar Racing Ltd, Ecurie Skymarc Farm & Ecurie Des Monceaux

runners.name: Oracle
runners.spotlight: No wins since his debut but produced plenty of decent efforts in Group company and he comes into this having recorded a career best behind Goliath in a 1m4f Group 2 on good ground when last seen in late May; player if the 69-day absence hasn't left him a little rusty; seems choice of the owner's retained rider.
runners.comment: Recorded a career best when last seen two months ago; seems choice of retained rider

runners.name: Mazzala
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten son of Frankel, who only made his debut at the beginning of May; improvement with every start, the last two over 1m4f on good ground, the most recent being a Listed event; almost certainly capable of better on this next step up the ladder, and needs to on the figures, but the owner's retained rider Maxime Guyon is booked to ride Oracle.
runners.comment: Unbeaten son of Frankel, who only debuted at the beginning of May; needs more on figures

runners.name: Uthred
runners.spotlight: Capable sort at his best as he showed when landing a 1m2f Listed race on heavy last summer at Compiegne (where he has a good record) before a respectable run in the Group 3 Prix du Prince d'Orange; didn't start this campaign strongly but did better last time and could find improvement for a first try over this distance (dam stayed this sort of trip).
runners.comment: Capable sort trying the trip for the first time; needs extra

races.race_name: Prix de la Vallee d'Auge (Listed Race) (Turf)
Prix Michel Houyvet (Listed Race) (Turf)

runners.name: Maria Apollonia
runners.owner: AP Racing SC, Armand Dahan et al

runners.name: Tardar
runners.owner: Ryszard Zielinski, Mme Alicja Karkosa & Andrzej Zielinski

races.race_name: Prix Isola Bella (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)

runners.name: La Mandala
runners.owner: Bernard Giraudon, Mme Solange Galewski & Jean-Francois Font

runners.name: Pyramide
runners.owner: Laurent Broomhead, Tony Clout Et Al

runners.name: Lingani
runners.spotlight: Great effort in the Santa Ana Lane Sprint Final Flemington two back. Just got there in the 4yo+ Hcp this track in rain affected going. Relishes the sting out of the ground. Fit from racing and right in the mix again.
runners.owner: G G Tully, T K Thompson Et Al

runners.name: Air Assault
runners.spotlight: First-up (21-weeks). Tends to race well first-up without winning. Prefers better than heavy. Best viewed as a rough place hope fresh in this line-up.
runners.owner: B H Perks, Ms A M Clough Et Al

runners.name: Lim's Saltoro
runners.spotlight: HK Import returning for second Australian campaign (56-weeks). Proven fresh performer. Has early speed. Keep safe.

runners.name: Sir Now
runners.spotlight: Pure speed merchant. Great effort in the Sir John Monash Stakes Caulfield two back. Brave after showing speed this venue. Sticky gate but has early pace. Must consider.
runners.owner: D L Hewitt & Ms J C Preston

runners.name: Mating Call
runners.spotlight: Resuming (13-weeks). Right amongst it in top company. Not beaten far Benchmark 72 company first-up last preparation. Finds a harder setup.

runners.name: Great Maximus
runners.spotlight: Caulfield (Bm84) placegetter 27 Jun. Not disgraced on a soft deck at Flemington over this journey at $12. Wet tracks certainly don't pose a problem. Worth a look.
runners.owner: R Jolly, J Bechara Et Al

runners.name: Tippa
runners.spotlight: Resuming after a (69-weeks) spell. Seasoned galloper best over longer these days. A the bottom of his win range here. Tough ask fresh off the long lay-off.
runners.owner: B J Bowman, G R Nilsson Et Al

runners.name: Swiftie Harriet
runners.spotlight: Now 4 weeks between runs. Just missed at Rosehill 27 Jun. Prominent, showed plenty of ticker in heavy ground to just go under at Randwick. Respecting.
runners.owner: T J Doudle, S D Bland Et Al

runners.name: Vestas
runners.spotlight: Kept fresh. Ridden back, battled home without threatening at Flemington. One for your exotics.

runners.name: Zunna
runners.spotlight: Fair performance without threatening on a soft deck at Sandown-Hillside at $5.50. Dual winner this trip. Capable of making an impact.

runners.name: Mystic Wonder
runners.spotlight: Freshened. Really good run in testing conditions coming from the back in (Bm76) at Morphettville Parks over longer assignment. Drops to shorter trip. Could get into the placings.
runners.owner: Ms J Heaney, R M Warnock Et Al

runners.name: Cicala
runners.spotlight: Not far off them in the small field this track. Has form in wet. All the better and not out of this.
runners.owner: Clarken Bloodstock, M K Jennings Et Al

runners.name: Shady Thinker
runners.spotlight: First-up (37-weeks). Latest trial work was solid. One for multiples fresh in this affair.
runners.owner: A Bain, Seymour Bloodstock Et Al
